jobs.description:
Director – Software Publisher Services – US (Remote)

"Are you looking for an opportunity to drive commercial growth, own strategic client relationships, and shape the future of software compliance advisory at a global level?"

About the Company

Connor Consulting Partners, LLC is a specialist advisory firm delivering software license compliance and advisory services to a global client base.

We are in an exciting period of growth and organisational maturity. Our line of business is structured so that every person operates at their highest value: Directors focus on client outcomes and commercial growth, a dedicated delivery management function provides the operational infrastructure, and Account Managers and Technical Leads run day-to-day execution with genuine autonomy. The result is a firm where senior leaders spend their time on the work that matters most - growing accounts and winning new business.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director to take ownership of a portfolio of client accounts within our Software Publishers Services line of business. This is a senior commercial role: you will be accountable for the revenue, growth, and quality outcomes your clients experience.

This is not a delivery management role. We have a mature delivery infrastructure - tracking systems, quality frameworks, structured escalation pathways, and a capable operations team - that handles day-to-day execution. Your focus will be on the outcomes that matter: growing your accounts, winning new business, maintaining senior client relationships, and ensuring the quality standard your clients receive meets the firm's expectations.

The right person for this role is a commercially-minded leader who has the confidence to step back from operational detail and trust a well-designed delivery system, while retaining clear accountability for results.

This role also carries a strategic dimension beyond day-to-day portfolio management. The software publisher services landscape is evolving. Publishers are shifting from audit enforcement toward models built around customer engagement and customer success, and we are actively leading that evolution. Connor is at the front of this change, helping publishers and their customers move toward advisory-led relationships that create lasting value on both sides. The Director we hire will help shape what that looks like in practice: driving the new services we take to market, influencing how publishers engage with their customers, and building the commercial credibility that positions Connor as the firm that leads with advisory, not audit. This is an opportunity to shape a business, not just run a book.

Key Accountabilities

Commercial Ownership

  • Full commercial authority across your client portfolio. You own all commitments made to clients on timelines, fees, and scope.
  • Drive account-level growth and revenue extraction from existing contracts. Identify and convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Pursue net-new client acquisition through your professional network and market presence. A significant portion of your time should be directed toward new business development.
  • Consult the delivery management function on capacity before finalising commercial commitments. You retain full authority to commit, and you own the delivery risk associated with your decisions.

Strategic Client Relationships

  • Maintain periodic senior-level touchpoints with your clients. Your presence is strategic, not operational.
  • You are the firm's senior face to the client. Engaged in operational client matters only when escalation is required or when commercial conversations demand your involvement.
  • Build and deepen the relationships that generate long-term account value. Your Account Managers handle the day-to-day; you hold the strategic relationship.

Quality Accountability

  • Ultimately accountable for the quality standard your clients experience. The delivery function provides quality frameworks, checklists, and tracking; you are accountable for the results those systems produce.
  • Hold your delivery teams accountable for the quality of every deliverable. When quality issues arise, you set the standard for what constitutes an acceptable resolution.
  • Champion and reinforce the firm's delivery standards within your accounts. Consistent quality is a business standard that depends on leadership at every level.

Delivery Oversight

  • Ultimately accountable for the quality standard your clients experience. The delivery function provides quality frameworks, checklists, and tracking; you are accountable for the results those systems produce.
  • Hold your delivery teams accountable for the quality of every deliverable. When quality issues arise, you set the standard for what constitutes an acceptable resolution.
  • Champion and reinforce the firm's delivery standards within your accounts. Consistent quality is a business standard that depends on leadership at every level.

New Business Development

  • Final accountability on escalation decisions within your client portfolio. You are the decision-maker when issues escalate beyond the operations team's authority.
  • Receive structured reporting on all active engagements across your portfolio. You do not need to be in every operational meeting - the delivery infrastructure gives you the visibility to make informed decisions at the right altitude.
  • Retain final say on staffing decisions for your accounts. The delivery function assesses capability and recommends; you make the call.

Shaping the Advisory Proposition

  • Help drive the firm’s publisher advisory services beyond traditional software license compliance. You will be expected to bring a point of view on what clients need, what the market will pay for, and how we differentiate.
  • Use your client relationships as a proving ground for advisory-led engagements. Test new service lines, identify what resonates commercially, and feed those insights back into the firm’s go-to-market strategy.
  • Champion the shift from reactive compliance work to proactive advisory across your portfolio. This means reframing client conversations around security, renewal optimization, and strategic licensing decisions, not just audit remediation.
  • Collaborate with the leadership team to build the firm’s advisory capability, including the skills, methodologies, and commercial models required to sustain advisory work at scale.

New Business Development

  • Lead net-new client acquisition in the software license compliance space. Leverage your industry network, market knowledge, and relationships to build the firm's pipeline.
  • Our organisational structure is specifically designed to free your time for growth activity. As the operations team runs delivery independently, you have the bandwidth to focus on the commercial opportunities that drive the firm forward.
  • Contribute to the firm's market positioning and thought leadership in software compliance and advisory.

What We Expect in Return

This role carries significant authority and autonomy. With that comes a set of commitments we expect from every Director:

  • Give the delivery function a forward view of your pipeline so they can plan capacity proactively. Last-minute resourcing requests undermine the system that supports you.
  • Consult on delivery capacity before making commitments to clients. This is not about seeking permission - it is about making informed decisions with the full picture.
  • Be transparent about the state of your accounts. Visibility across the leadership team is how we catch issues early and support each other.
  • Reinforce the firm's delivery standards within your accounts. Process compliance and quality frameworks only work when leadership at every level backs them.
  • Collaborate openly with your peers. Share information, share best practice, and operate as a coherent leadership group - not as isolated client silos.
  • Treat the delivery management function as a genuine partner. They provide the infrastructure that frees you to focus on growth; engage with them accordingly.

How This Role Works Day-to-Day

We have deliberately structured this role so you can operate at the highest level. Here is what that looks like in practice:

Your focus

Revenue, growth, client relationships, quality outcomes, strategic decisions

Not your focus

Day-to-day delivery management, project tracking, process design, resource pool management - we have dedicated people and infrastructure for this

Your governance rhythm

Structured weekly and monthly forums with the leadership team to review portfolio health, make decisions, and align on priorities. You receive the data you need to stay informed without being operationally involved.

How you get visibility

Through dashboards, structured reporting, and governance forums - not through attending every meeting. The delivery infrastructure is designed to give you confidence without requiring your presence in operational detail.

When you step in

When issues genuinely require your authority: material commercial risk, client escalations, staffing decisions, and significant scope or fee changes. Routine delivery is handled by your operations team.

What your team handles

Day-to-day client communication, project management, routine budget conversations, weekly tracking, and phase management - all owned by your Account Managers and Technical Leads.

About You

Experience & Knowledge

  • Significant experience in software license compliance, software asset management, or software advisory services. You understand the commercial landscape, vendor licensing models, and the compliance audit lifecycle.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing a client portfolio in a professional services or advisory environment. You have managed commercial relationships at a senior level and have delivered measurable revenue growth.
  • Experience leading delivery teams in a matrix structure. You know how to get results through people who do not report directly to you, and you understand the discipline of stepping back from operational detail while retaining accountability.
  • Understanding of major software vendors' licensing programmes (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, IBM, or similar). You can speak credibly to clients about compliance risk, remediation strategy, and commercial optimisation.
  • International delivery experience preferred. Our teams operate across multiple regions and you will be comfortable working across time zones and cultures.

Leadership & Competencies

  • Commercially driven. You think in terms of revenue, margin, and account growth. You see client relationships as commercial assets to be developed.
  • Confident delegator. You trust capable people to execute and do not need to be in every meeting to feel in control. You lead through outcomes, not through presence.
  • Collaborative. You work effectively with peers and support functions. You treat delivery infrastructure as something that enables you, not as overhead. You share information openly and engage constructively when issues arise.
  • Decisive. You make commercial decisions clearly and own the consequences. When delivery risk is flagged, you weigh it and commit consciously.
  • Growth-oriented. You actively pursue new business and are energised by client acquisition, not just client management.
  • Quality-conscious. You hold a high standard for what your clients receive and you hold your teams accountable for meeting that standard.

Qualifications

  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant industry certifications are advantageous but not essential (e.g., ITAM, SAM, vendor-specific compliance certifications).
  • Established professional network within the software compliance and advisory sector.

What We Offer

  • A senior leadership position with genuine commercial authority and client ownership.
  • An organisational structure specifically designed to free you from operational detail so you can focus on growth and strategic client value.
  • A delivery infrastructure - tracking, quality frameworks, structured governance - that provides visibility and support without requiring your day-to-day involvement.
  • A collaborative leadership team with shared information and mutual support.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing practice in a specialist advisory firm with a global client base.
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with the seniority and commercial impact of the role.

Benefits - Why Connor?

We approach every relationship with purpose, attention, and a little fun! You can expect a flexible working environment, paid mental health days, a generous vacation package, and competitive compensation. You’ll be working with a highly driven, collaborative global team that values trust, accountability, and continuous learning. We nurture our people in a culture that promotes diversity and individuality that sparks innovation and creativity.

Connor Consulting Partners Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity, equality, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you are a professional who is looking for an opportunity where you can put your honed skills and abilities to work for a mission that you are passionate about, then this is the right career opportunity for you.

Join us and be part of our Global Team. Apply now!

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Tech Lead to drive delivery and cross-team coordination for the Shop Builder DevX and AI team. You are the bridge between architecture and execution: you take the technical direction set by the Principal Engineer and turn it into a running, shipping team.

You lead a squad of three engineers building the developer surface that Shop Builder is missing — MCP server, CLI, SDK, documentation pipeline, local dev environment, deploy and versioning path. You set the delivery cadence, remove blockers, coordinate inbound dependencies from payments, auth, live ops, and catalog, and own the quality of what ships.

This is a hands-on role. You write production code, lead code reviews, and drive technical decisions within your domain. You also have the seniority and judgment to coordinate across teams and represent the team's work to engineering leadership.

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global payments and commerce platform for the games industry, used by thousands of publishers to monetize, distribute, and operate their titles worldwide. Shop Builder is Xsolla's storefront platform — used by publishers and game developers to launch and operate game shops, from straightforward catalog and webshops to fully custom storefronts built headless on our backend. For more information, visit xsolla.com.

The DevX and AI team owns the public APIs, documentation, and AI features that give developers — and AI agents — the full surface they need to customize and extend Shop Builder. This is a net-new team of seven, standing up to fill a real gap: no dedicated team has owned the developer surface end to end. That changes now.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the delivery of the Shop Builder developer surface: MCP server, CLI and local dev environment, public SDK, documentation pipeline, sandbox and preview environments, deploy and versioning path.

  • Lead and mentor a team of three engineers — setting technical direction within the squad, running code reviews, and ensuring consistent engineering quality.

  • Own cross-team coordination: identify and pull inbound API capabilities from payments, auth, live ops, and catalog teams; unblock dependencies; manage integration timelines.

  • Actively contribute to implementation — you ship production code alongside the team, particularly on the most critical and complex components.

  • Partner with the Principal Engineer to translate architecture decisions into sprint-level execution plans and realistic timelines.

  • Collaborate with the PO on roadmap sequencing, scope decisions, and trade-offs between speed and correctness.

  • Own the team's delivery rhythm: sprint planning, technical grooming, retrospectives, and status visibility to engineering and business leadership.

  • Define and maintain the team's engineering standards: testing strategy, observability, deployment practices, and documentation quality.

  • Act as the primary technical contact for integrations with headless partners and the MIT professional services team during early partner onboarding.

  • Contribute to hiring by conducting technical interviews and defining what great looks like for the engineers joining this team.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a tech lead, staff, or senior lead role driving delivery across a team.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js, with experience shipping production APIs, CLIs, or SDKs to external developers.

  • Hands-on experience building CLI tools and developer-facing workflows: command design, config file formats, local dev loops, deploy commands, and error messages that actually help.

  • Solid understanding of REST API design principles, SDK ergonomics, and what makes a developer experience work — you have strong opinions and can back them up.

  • Practical familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agentic tool-use patterns: you understand how AI agents consume tool interfaces and what makes a tool reliable for an LLM.

  • Experience coordinating across multiple engineering teams to ship features that depend on inbound capabilities you don't own.

  • Proven ability to lead engineers: clear technical direction, raising the quality bar through reviews, developing other engineers' skills.

  • Cloud-native experience: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and deployment automation on AWS or GCP.

  • Strong communication skills — you translate technical complexity into clear status for leadership, and technical requirements into actionable work for your team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in game tech, digital commerce, storefront platforms, or headless architecture.

  • Background building React component libraries, design systems, or frontend platforms consumed by external developers.

  • Experience building sandboxed execution environments for third-party code (custom blocks, extensions, plugins).

  • Familiarity with LLM-generated code evaluation: assessing whether an AI-produced block, component, or layout is correct and safe to ship.

  • Prior experience standing up a greenfield team from scratch and knowing what that demands.

  • Exposure to documentation-as-code workflows and toolchains that publish to multiple surfaces from a single source of truth.

Benefits:
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in federal construction management, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in a remote environment.

  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Manage change control processes, issue resolution, and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Coordinate site surveys, engineering support, and technical deliverables.

Team Development & Business Support

  • Support proposal development and follow-on task order opportunities.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.

Certifications

jobs.excerpt: About Future Group Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product to join our purpose-led, high-growth scale-up. This role exists to lead both the ongoing management and change delivery of Future Group’s product suite across accumulation and retirement.
You’ll lead a team of Product Managers and work closely with our Head of Product and teams across Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Finance, Investments and Disclosure. It’s a role for someone who enjoys bringing people together, navigating complexity and turning good product thinking into well-governed, well-executed outcomes for members.
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at

The Role As our Senior Manager, Product, you’ll have responsibility for two equally important parts of our product world: keeping our existing products well-managed, competitive and compliant, and leading approved product changes from business case through to implementation.
On the ongoing product management side, you’ll oversee our accumulation and retirement product suite, including product performance and reporting, competitor benchmarking, APRA reporting, member outcomes assessments, and our DDO and TMD obligations. You’ll help give the Head of Product and senior stakeholders a clear picture of how our products are performing, where the market is moving and where we need to act.
On the change side, you’ll develop robust business cases and lead product initiatives end-to-end, bringing together teams across Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Finance and Disclosure to turn approved ideas into reality. You’ll make sure changes are commercially sound, operationally achievable, compliant and delivered with members front of mind.
You’ll also lead and develop a team of Product Managers, setting clear priorities and building capability across both ongoing product management and change delivery.
This is a role with plenty of breadth and influence. You’ll be close to the detail when it matters, while also bringing the judgement and perspective needed to advise on product design, lifecycle decisions, regulatory obligations and delivery risks.

You'll love this job if

  • You find superannuation opaque and frustrating, if you had the chance to revolutionise the industry to be better for people, you would
  • You love sharing your ideas and seeing what happens. At this scale-up, you're not just a small fish in a big pond. Your contributions have a direct influence on our impact and how we work
  • You like to be kept on your toes - change is inevitable here. You like to tackle new challenges, and maybe even discover talents you never knew you had
  • You enjoy the combination of strategy and execution. You can zoom out to understand where a product needs to go, then zoom back in to make sure the details, governance and delivery stack up
  • You’re comfortable navigating complexity and regulation without losing sight of the people our products exist to serve
  • You thrive at pace, comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment without losing your composure or attention to detail
  • You get energy from bringing different teams together, creating clarity and getting things moving – even when you don’t have direct authority over everyone involved
  • You’re a thoughtful people leader who enjoys helping others grow, while setting clear expectations and maintaining a high bar for quality

We're looking for someone who

  • Believes in Future Group’s mission and has a passion for moving Australia’s money out of fossil-fuels and into renewable energy
  • Believes in using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world
  • Brings 7+ years’ experience in financial services, including meaningful experience in superannuation product management across accumulation and retirement
  • Is a strong all-rounder, with substantive experience spanning insurance, investments and retirement product management, and is comfortable moving fluidly across all three
  • Has demonstrated experience leading end-to-end product change in a regulated environment, from developing the business case through to implementation
  • Has strong working knowledge of the Australian superannuation regulatory environment, including APRA and ASIC obligations, DDO and SPS 515
  • Can develop clear, commercially sound business cases and product documentation for executive or trustee decision-making
  • Has experience leading or managing a small team and is motivated by developing great product people
  • Is a clear communicator who can make complex product and regulatory concepts understandable to different audiences
  • Brings sound judgement, commercial awareness and a structured approach to product governance, documentation and delivery
  • Is RG 146 compliant or equivalent and holds a bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Law or a related discipline (desirable)
Some nice-to-haves but are not essential are:
  • Experience with APRA product reporting and regulatory returns, member outcomes assessments under SPS 515, and DDO obligations including TMD preparation and review
  • Experience with competitor benchmarking, APRA heatmaps and the Your Future Your Super performance test
  • Experience reviewing or contributing to disclosure documentation such as PDSs, SENs and TMDs
  • Experience with Successor Fund Transfers, trustee transition programs or similarly complex product transitions
  • Experience working with executive and trustee governance forums
  • A postgraduate qualification such as an MBA or Finance qualification, or professional certification such as CA, CPA or FINSIA
Don’t tick all the boxes? That’s okay, we like thinking outside the box anyway. We value skills, passion and who you are over what you’ve done or where you’ve studied. So if this job strikes a chord, we want to hear from you!

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable
  • Other perks such as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), the ability to purchase leave, novated leasing arrangements for electric vehicles, and a few more to find out!

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE:At Accela, our Enterprise Customer Success Managers are essential to building lasting, high-impact relationships with our most strategic customers and ensuring they achieve their goals through our innovative solutions.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

At Accela, our Enterprise Customer Success Managers are essential to building lasting, high-impact relationships with our most strategic customers and ensuring they achieve their goals through our innovative solutions. As an Enterprise CSM, you will work closely with a large portfolio of enterprise-level government agency customers to develop comprehensive Account Plans that align with their long-term objectives. You will be responsible for monitoring customer health, driving product adoption, ensuring customer satisfaction, and facilitating customer loyalty at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with various internal teams, leverage CSM and Gov Tech industry best practices, and significantly impact our customers' success.

Accela provides a robust cloud-based platform of government software solutions that accelerate growth, efficiency, and transparency in communities of all sizes. Our customers are government agencies looking to improve citizen engagement, streamline processes, and enhance service delivery. By leveraging our platform, they can do more with less, providing consistent and convenient services to the public.

Our Customer Success approach is built on establishing clear customer goals, driving adoption, ensuring value realization, fostering customer advocacy, managing relationships proactively, anticipating and solving potential issues, and continuously improving our strategies. By incorporating these principles, you will help create a seamless and valuable experience for our enterprise customers in the Gov Tech industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage a large portfolio of enterprise government agency customers, delivering high-touch engagement and strategic guidance at scale.
  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, includingCXO-level contacts on both the IT and business sides of the organization.
  • Develop 3-5 year strategic agency plans in partnership with customers, aligned to Accela's product roadmap and the agency's long-term goals.
  • Travel regularly to customer sites to conduct walk-the-halls engagement, strengthen relationships, and deepen organizational awareness.
  • Own renewal health for the portfolio, proactively identifying and managing at-risk accounts, forecasting renewal outcomes, and driving retention through consistent value attainment.
  • Partner closely with Sales to identify, develop, and advance upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the enterprise portfolio.
  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards and deliver compelling data stories that communicate customer progress, outcomes, and Accela's impact to both internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Benchmark customer outcomes against industry peers and best practices, helping customers understand their performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Identify AI use cases specific to each customer's workflows and track AI feature adoption as a key health and engagement signal.
  • Leverage AI tools and capabilities to scale customer success activities across a large portfolio without sacrificing quality of engagement.
  • Develop, implement, and track goals using the Objective and Key Results (OKR) framework.
  • Advocate for customer needs within the organization through formal Voice of the Customer (VoC) processes, ensuring enterprise feedback directly influences product and service development.
  • Flag competitive displacement risks at accounts and surface competitive intelligence to internal teams.
  • Identify and develop peer reference opportunities and partner with Marketing to develop case studies that turn healthy accounts into advocates.
  • Manage escalations end to end, owning the escalation path from intake through resolution.
  • Mentor and provide informal leadership to CSM teammates, sharing enterprise best practices and success methodologies across the team.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in an enterprise or senior CSM capacity.
  • Experience in Gov Tech or the public sector is required.
  • Deep expertise in Gainsight, including health scores, playbooks, reporting, and driving customer outcomes across a large portfolio.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute enterprise-level customer success strategies, account plans, and multi-year strategic plans.
  • Strong data analysis and visualization skills, including KPI dashboard development and data storytelling for executive audiences.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-level stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging CXO-level contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to own renewal health, forecast risk, and drive retention across a large book of business.
  • Experience partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell motions within an enterprise customer portfolio.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to identify and track AI use cases and adoption within customer workflows.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for on-site customer engagement.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Knowledge of the Accela Civic Platform and its applications.
  • Experience with OKR frameworks and enterprise customer results strategies.
  • Experience benchmarking customer outcomes and communicating performance against industry peers.
  • Experience developing customer references, case studies, or participating in customer advisory boards (CABs).
  • Strong understanding of competitive landscape in Gov Tech and ability to flag and communicate displacement risks.
  • Experience leading or mentoring CSM teammates in an informal leadership capacity.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities across a large portfolio.

ABOUT ACCELA
For nearly 20 years, Accela has been an industry leader in designing and delivering government software to improve efficiency, increase citizen engagement and enable the development of thriving communities. Today, citizens are savvy to how services should be delivered, and expect a consistently convenient, openly transparent view into their local government. While government agencies struggle to do more with less, our mission has never been more critical. jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

jobs.description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a results-driven Senior Media Buyer to own and scale paid social advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale Facebook and Instagram (Meta) advertising campaigns that generate measurable business results. You’ll work closely with clients, creative teams, and internal stakeholders to improve campaign performance, reduce acquisition costs, and maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, thrive on testing new strategies, and enjoy making data-driven decisions that directly impact client success, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Strategy & Management

  • Build, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through execution.
  • Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring campaigns achieve performance goals.
  • Optimize:
    • Campaign structures
    • Audiences
    • Placements
    • Bidding strategies
    • Budgets
  • Scale winning campaigns while maintaining profitability and efficiency.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze key metrics including:
    • CPL
    • CPA
    • ROAS
    • CTR
    • CPC
    • Conversion Rate
  • Test new:
    • Audiences
    • Offers
    • Creatives
    • Landing pages
    • Campaign strategies
  • Continuously improve lead quality while reducing acquisition costs.

Creative Strategy

  • Develop creative concepts and campaign messaging.
  • Write detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing ad creatives.
  • Analyze creative performance and recommend new testing initiatives.

Client Communication & Reporting

  • Present campaign performance updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Recommend strategies for scaling successful campaigns and improving underperforming accounts.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

Growth & Innovation

  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.
  • Test new campaign strategies, automation tools, and optimization techniques.
  • Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and campaign performance.
  • Contribute innovative ideas that strengthen agency performance.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently achieve or exceed performance goals.
  • Client acquisition costs decrease while ROAS improves.
  • Advertising budgets scale profitably.
  • Clients receive clear reporting and strategic recommendations.
  • Creative testing generates continuous performance improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and retention remain high.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine creativity with analytical decision-making.
  • You enjoy testing, optimizing, and scaling paid campaigns.
  • You’re comfortable managing multiple high-budget accounts simultaneously.
  • You proactively identify opportunities for performance improvement.
  • You communicate campaign insights clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven remote environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing $10,000+ per month in advertising spend.
  • Experience managing five or more client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Meta Business Manager
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion API (CAPI)
    • Event Tracking
  • Experience optimizing campaigns for:
    • Lead generation
    • Customer acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make optimization decisions.
  • Experience developing creative strategies and writing creative briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Digital marketing agency experience.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Landing Page Optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance or creative workflows.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

Tech Stack

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Meta Business Manager
  • Meta Pixel
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Close CRM
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Workspace
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign performance dashboards.
  • Monitor spend, ROAS, CPL, CPA, and conversion metrics.
  • Optimize campaign audiences, creatives, and bidding strategies.
  • Develop creative concepts and collaborate with designers.
  • Meet with clients to review campaign performance and recommendations.
  • Launch new campaigns and A/B tests.
  • Analyze results and implement optimization strategies.
  • Research Meta platform updates and emerging advertising trends.

In short: You’ll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of Meta advertising campaigns while helping clients maximize growth through data-driven paid media strategies.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  • Conversion Rate.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Campaign scalability and profitability.
  • Creative testing success rate.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own high-impact Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through optimization.
  • Work closely with clients and creative teams to drive measurable business growth.
  • Opportunity to manage significant advertising budgets and multiple client portfolios.
  • Exposure to advanced paid media strategies and emerging advertising technologies.
  • Fully remote work environment aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Career progression into:
    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your paid media experience, and explain how you’ve managed Meta advertising campaigns, optimized campaign performance, scaled ad spend, and improved ROAS across multiple client accounts. You’ll also have the opportunity to showcase your analytical approach, creative strategy, and experience collaborating with clients and creative teams. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving forward to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about paid social advertising, thrive on optimizing performance, and enjoy helping clients grow through data-driven Meta campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and make a measurable impact through high-performing digital advertising strategies.

The Sr. BI Analyst delivers actionable insights through analysis, reporting, and visualization on large, complex projects, and serves as the Power BI subject matter expert for the organization. This is a senior individual-contributor role: the analyst works independently, mentors less experienced colleagues, and partners directly with business stakeholders and leaders to turn ambiguous questions into scalable, automated solutions.

The ideal candidate brings strong critical thinking - able to decompose an unclear business problem, challenge the assumptions behind a request, and choose the right approach rather than simply building what was asked - paired with fluent, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to accelerate analysis, automate manual work, and design solutions that scale. As AI reshapes BI work, we expect this role to actively apply it, not just be aware of it.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and manage business intelligence solutions on complex projects of large scope - dashboards, reports, ad-hoc datasets, and visualizations that guide business decisions.
  • Partner with Product, Actuarial & Advanced Analytics, Underwriting, and other core insurance functions to collect, structure, and validate data from multiple sources.
  • Audit, compile, and reconcile data to ensure accuracy and integrity.
  • Communicate findings clearly to business stakeholders and senior leaders - translating technical analysis into plain-language recommendations, defending methodology when challenged, and providing consultative input beyond what was asked.
  • Automate manual reporting processes and build scalable, reusable solutions rather than one-off deliverables.
  • Apply AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and similar) to accelerate dashboard development, pipeline automation, code generation and review, and report QA - and champion AI-driven process improvement across the BI function.
  • Apply critical thinking to ambiguous requests - clarify the underlying business question, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend the approach rather than defaulting to the one requested.
  • Conduct peer reviews of colleagues' work and mentor less experienced analysts as the Power BI subject matter expert.
  • Support the implementation of new practices, processes, and procedures.

Education, Experience, Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 5–7 years of data analytics or related experience.
  • Advanced SQL, data modeling, and visualization; recognized Power BI subject matter expertise (Tableau or other BI tools a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, including:
    • OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Notebooks, Pipelines, Dataflows, Power BI integration, and Python for Fabric Notebooks.
  • Solid grasp of database structures, relationships, and dependencies.
  • Strong critical thinking and proactive problem-solving - comfortable working from an ambiguous request to a defined, scalable solution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with business stakeholders and senior leaders; able to present findings and influence decisions without technical jargon.
  • Peer mentoring and peer review capabilities.
  • Intermediate insurance domain knowledge and understanding of MGA operations; insurance industry experience preferred.
  • Advanced, hands-on AI fluency - daily working use of tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot. Candidates should be prepared to describe a specific problem they solved or automated with AI. Specifically:
    • Accelerating analysis, report automation, SQL/Python code generation and review, and documentation.
    • Effective prompting and AI workflow design, with the judgment to validate AI output.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas, charts, and graphing).

We are hiring a Supply Chain & Procurement Director for a fast-growing functional beverage brand in the US. The company manufactures and sells a colorful, flavor-forward product line at significant scale, with 100+ active SKUs, weekly new flavor drops, and a tolling-based manufacturing model across 50+ ingredients.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can keep a fast-moving product calendar fully supplied without overbuying. You will own planning, procurement, manufacturing coordination, and inventory across the entire operation, and you will be the person who spots shortages, bottlenecks, and risks before they turn into stockouts.

What You Will Do

Supply Chain Planning

  • Own the end to end supply chain planning process across raw materials, packaging, finished goods, production timelines, and inventory availability
  • Ensure the brand is never out of stock and is prepared for rapid sales spikes, limited edition drops, and weekly product launches
  • Build and maintain systems that support 100+ active SKUs and frequent new flavor innovation
  • Partner with manufacturing, operations, finance, product development, and leadership to align production planning with demand
  • Identify bottlenecks, risks, and shortages before they become business problems

Procurement & Raw Material Management

  • Manage procurement across 50+ ingredients, including flavor systems, functional ingredients, packaging, and other raw materials
  • Own supplier relationships and negotiate aggressively to secure the lowest possible cost without compromising quality, lead times, or supply reliability
  • Build multiple sourcing options for critical ingredients to reduce dependency and improve leverage
  • Monitor lead times, MOQs, price changes, supplier capacity, and inventory risk
  • Drive continuous cost savings across the supply base

Manufacturing Coordination

  • Work directly with toll manufacturers to ensure production is completed on time, in full, and to quality standards
  • Track production schedules, ingredient availability, packaging readiness, and finished goods output
  • Hold manufacturing partners accountable to agreed timelines, quality standards, and service levels
  • Escalate issues quickly and solve problems in real time
  • Support rapid product drops and innovation cycles without sacrificing execution quality

Inventory, Forecasting & Cash Conversion

  • Maintain accurate inventory visibility across raw materials, packaging, WIP, and finished goods
  • Build planning tools and reporting that help the business make fast, informed inventory decisions
  • Balance inventory availability with cash discipline, avoiding both stockouts and unnecessary overbuying
  • Improve the cash conversion cycle through smarter purchasing, better production planning, and tighter inventory management
  • Analyze demand patterns, drop performance, reorder needs, and SKU velocity

Quality & On Time Execution

  • Ensure every product is produced to specification and meets brand quality expectations
  • Partner with QA and manufacturing teams to address product, ingredient, packaging, or production issues immediately
  • Ensure product availability supports fast shipping, accurate orders, and a strong customer experience
  • Protect the brand by making sure supply chain execution matches the speed of customer demand

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

    • Proven experience in supply chain, procurement, production planning, manufacturing coordination, or operations leadership
    • Experience with food, beverage, supplements, CPG, powders, stick packs, or high SKU consumer products strongly preferred
    • Strong procurement and supplier negotiation skills
    • Highly analytical with excellent Excel skills
    • Strong written and verbal communication, with fast, clear, and accurate responses
    • Strong understanding of inventory planning, lead times, purchase orders, production schedules, and the cash conversion cycle
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, vendors, ingredients, timelines, and urgent issues at once
    • Extremely detail oriented and highly accountable
    • Comfortable in a fast paced, high pressure, high growth environment
    • Willingness to be highly responsive outside traditional business hours when the business requires it

Details

Position Title: AI & Automations Associate

Reports to: Principal Product Manager (for product direction, priorities and outcomes)

Works within: the Technology function, with a dotted line to an Engineering/Platform lead for technical standards, code review, security and deployment

Location: UK, Remote

Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About BibliU

BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. We've cracked the code on Day 1 access to affordable digital course materials for students, while delivering comprehensive campus store solutions that foster human relationships, and increase our stickiness in the world of AI.

The result? Measurable impact: 10% higher student retention, 1-point GPA increases, and partnerships with 170 universities serving 600,000 students each year.

We've fundamentally changed how universities procure, distribute, and manage learning content. We partner with 4,000+ publishers, including Pearson, Oxford University Press, and Wiley to deliver content to universities, and provide rich engagement data and interactive tools like quizzes that help students actually learn.

Here's what makes our story compelling:

Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). In late 2023, we acquired Texas Book Company (now 'BibliU Campus') to become the only fully vertically integrated player in the market, driving US organic growth which now represents 90% of our business.

We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

Position Overview

This is a brand new hire! We are looking for someone who will be tasked with building software automations to help teams at BibliU reduce their manual work & improve their productivity. This will include both integrating best-in-class software, AI workflows, as well as building custom software.

This person will embed themselves into our teams that then use these automations, while being part of the product and technology functions. This structure is intended to ensure this role remains close to teams that will make use of their work, so they can deeply understand their context and requirements, with the central function driving best practice, professional development and support.

This role sits deliberately across product and engineering, with support from both teams: the Principal Product Manager provides line management and supports product craft excellence, while an Engineering manager provides feedback on build quality (code quality, security, deployment and maintainability) and supports the person's technical growth.

We would expect the successful person to use significant amounts of AI to build custom software - given the significant productivity benefits AI brings to software development. The ideal candidate will have experience using AI to plan, build, test and deploy software, and be able to share specific examples of projects they have developed.

We would also expect the successful candidate to exhibit strong product thinking - and be confident talking to users to understand their requirements, developing user experiences that are intuitive and easy to learn and understand, and critically assessing their work to seek opportunity for continuous improvement.

Must have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree;
  • Proficient building full-stack software applications used in production;
  • Proficient in using agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor);
  • Strong product thinking: confident talking to users, framing problems, prioritising, and designing intuitive experiences (not just building to spec).
  • A habit of critically assessing your own work and looking for the next improvement.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Good to have:

  • Interest in higher education industry;
  • Interest in teaching others how to use more AI.
  • Comfort working across product and engineering rather than in one lane.

Benefits

Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.

Here's what we offer:

  • 🌴 35 days holiday per year (excluding public holidays!) - yep, that’s not a typo!
  • 🎂 Your birthday off
  • 🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year
  • ❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK
  • 💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station
  • 🚴 Cycle-to-work scheme (UK)
  • 🛟 Life Insurance up to 4 x salary
  • ❤️ Private health insurance
  • 👁️ Annual eye test and up to £100 towards frames for glasses required for DSE work

We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.

Please note: We do not work with external recruiters/recruitment agencies. This position will be filled directly by BibliU and we kindly request that external recruiters/recruitment agencies refrain from submitting candidates for this role.

jobs.description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Figma & Design Systems | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer to create intuitive, scalable, and visually polished digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is not a purely visual UI design role. You’ll own the product design process from user research and UX flows through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex workflows and create experiences that are functional, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.

If you combine strong UX thinking, UI craftsmanship, product problem-solving, and Figma expertise, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user interviews, usability tests, surveys, and product research
  • Identify user pain points, friction, and product improvement opportunities
  • Create:
    • Personas
    • Journey maps
    • User flows
    • Interaction models
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Hotjar
  • Translate research and product insights into actionable design decisions

UX Design & Product Flows

  • Design intuitive workflows across web and mobile products
  • Translate product requirements into:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
  • Simplify complex interactions into clear, easy-to-use experiences
  • Consider edge cases and different user states throughout the design process
  • Iterate quickly based on user, product, and stakeholder feedback

UI Design & Prototyping

  • Create polished, high-fidelity product interfaces using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Design responsive experiences across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Establish clear:
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Interaction patterns
    • Micro-interactions
    • Interface consistency
  • Balance visual quality with usability and product functionality

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems
  • Develop reusable component libraries
  • Define standards for:
    • Typography
    • Spacing
    • Color
    • Icons
    • Components
    • UI patterns
  • Maintain consistency across products and features
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through structured systems

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define requirements and priorities
  • Collaborate with engineers throughout implementation
  • Prepare developer-ready:
    • Designs
    • Assets
    • Specifications
    • Documentation
  • Use Figma Dev Mode or similar workflows for efficient handoff
  • Review implementations and help resolve design discrepancies
  • Support QA and refinement through development and release

Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct usability reviews on existing and newly launched experiences
  • Gather user and stakeholder feedback after releases
  • Run or support A/B tests to validate design decisions
  • Analyze product performance and identify UX improvements
  • Continuously iterate to improve:
    • Usability
    • Engagement
    • Retention
    • Task completion

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
  • Experience designing responsive web and mobile products
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Interaction design
    • Usability
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and engineering teams
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and UX problem-solving, not just visual design
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS platforms
    • B2B products
    • Consumer applications
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Optimizely
    • Hotjar
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS or front-end development fundamentals
  • Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think about user problems before pixels
  • Can simplify complicated workflows into intuitive experiences
  • Balance user needs with business and technical requirements
  • Think in systems, components, and scalable patterns
  • Communicate and defend design decisions clearly
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers and engineers
  • Care about implementation quality, not just the Figma file
  • Move quickly while maintaining attention to detail

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review user behavior and identify UX opportunities
  • Map user journeys and product flows
  • Create wireframes and interactive prototypes
  • Design polished interfaces in Figma
  • Review requirements with Product Managers
  • Collaborate with engineers on implementation details
  • Review builds and resolve UX/UI inconsistencies
  • Maintain reusable components and design systems
  • Conduct usability testing and analyze feedback
  • Iterate on existing features based on user and product data

In short: you turn product ideas and user problems into intuitive, scalable, and polished digital experiences that people can use effortlessly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and task completion rates
  • Increased user engagement and retention
  • Design system consistency and adoption
  • On-time delivery of designs and prototypes
  • Reduced design-related implementation rework
  • Successful product and engineering handoffs
  • Positive user and stakeholder feedback

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own the complete product design lifecycle
  • Work directly with product and engineering teams
  • Solve meaningful UX and workflow challenges
  • Influence both product experience and design systems
  • Design across web and mobile environments
  • High ownership in a remote product environment
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • UX Lead
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Task
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have a strong Product Design or UX/UI portfolio
  • Enjoy solving complex user and workflow problems
  • Are highly proficient in Figma and modern product design practices
  • Think beyond visual design and understand the complete user experience
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with product and engineering teams

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build intuitive, scalable digital products that deliver exceptional user experiences.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with product design, UX/UI, Figma, user research, prototyping, design systems, and collaborating with product and engineering teams.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

Pay, benefits and more.
