Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Property Management Sales

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) with a background in property management or real estate sales to convert inbound opportunities into long-term clients.

This is not a cold prospecting role. You’ll work primarily with property owners, landlords, and real estate investors who have already expressed interest in property management services.

Your focus will be on:

  • Rapid inbound lead response
  • Lead qualification and conversion
  • Property management sales
  • Relationship building
  • Persistent follow-up
  • CRM and pipeline management
  • Moving qualified prospects toward signed agreements

Success in this role comes down to speed to contact, strong phone communication, trust-building, and disciplined follow-up.

If you understand property management and know how to turn interested property owners into clients, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Lead Conversion

  • Respond quickly to inbound property management leads provided by the company.
  • Connect with prospective property owners, landlords, and investors by phone, email, and other communication channels.
  • Understand each prospect’s portfolio, challenges, needs, and expectations.
  • Explain property management services clearly and confidently.
  • Position solutions based on the prospect’s specific situation.
  • Move qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline toward signed agreements.
  • Maintain urgency without creating a high-pressure sales experience.

Property Management Sales

Conduct consultative conversations with prospective clients to understand needs related to:

  • Tenant management
  • Leasing
  • Rent collection
  • Maintenance coordination
  • Property operations
  • Portfolio management

Communicate the value of professional property management and help prospects understand how the company’s services can address their operational challenges.

Relationship Building & Follow-Up

  • Build trust and credibility quickly with property owners and investors.
  • Execute persistent, organized follow-up across active opportunities.
  • Re-engage warm leads that are not ready to make an immediate decision.
  • Maintain communication throughout longer sales cycles.
  • Ensure no qualified lead goes untouched or misses a scheduled follow-up.
  • Deliver a responsive and professional client experience from first contact through close.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate CRM records covering:

  • Calls
  • Emails
  • Follow-ups
  • Prospect needs
  • Sales conversations
  • Lead status
  • Next steps
  • Deal stages
  • Conversion activity

Keep the sales pipeline organized and ensure leadership has clear visibility into opportunity progression.

Sales Pipeline Execution

  • Prioritize new inbound leads based on urgency and opportunity.
  • Track prospects through each stage of the sales process.
  • Identify stalled opportunities and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up schedules.
  • Take ownership of moving opportunities toward conversion.
  • Track individual activity and conversion performance.

Collaboration & Market Feedback

Work closely with marketing and leadership to:

  • Share feedback on lead quality.
  • Identify recurring prospect questions and objections.
  • Improve sales messaging and positioning.
  • Highlight opportunities to improve conversion rates.
  • Share insights from conversations with property owners and investors.

Stay informed on property management trends, landlord challenges, investor priorities, and competing services.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, client acquisition, or account management.
  • Direct experience in property management sales, real estate sales, property management operations, or a closely related real estate environment.
  • Strong understanding of property owners, landlords, rental properties, or real estate investors.
  • Proven ability to convert leads through phone-based sales conversations.
  • Strong CRM and sales pipeline management experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication.
  • Confidence speaking with U.S.-based clients over the phone.
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building ability.
  • Excellent follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple inbound opportunities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to work EST business hours.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Selling property management services.
  • Selling services to landlords or real estate investors.
  • Experience with residential property management.
  • Rental property operations experience.
  • Knowledge of real estate investment markets.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based property owners.
  • Experience converting warm or inbound leads.
  • Remote sales experience.
  • Familiarity with property management or real estate CRM systems.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Respond to new opportunities quickly.
  • Are confident and professional on the phone.
  • Understand how property owners and investors think.
  • Build trust without sounding overly aggressive or scripted.
  • Ask strong questions before recommending a solution.
  • Follow up consistently when prospects are not ready to buy immediately.
  • Stay organized while managing multiple active opportunities.
  • Take ownership of pipeline movement and conversion.
  • Enjoy relationship-driven sales.
  • Understand that many deals are won through consistent follow-through rather than a single conversation.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A typical day may include:

  • Reviewing and responding to new inbound leads.
  • Calling prospective property owners and investors.
  • Conducting qualification and sales conversations.
  • Understanding prospects’ properties, challenges, and management needs.
  • Following up with warm leads evaluating property management services.
  • Re-engaging prospects from previous conversations.
  • Updating CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Tracking scheduled follow-ups and next steps.
  • Coordinating internally on qualified opportunities.
  • Reviewing conversion performance and pipeline activity.

In short: you turn inbound property management inquiries into long-term clients through fast response, strong communication, relationship-building, and persistent follow-up.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Speed to contact for new inbound leads
  • Lead-to-client conversion rate
  • Number of qualified sales conversations
  • Signed property management agreements
  • Pipeline progression and deal velocity
  • Follow-up completion rate
  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene
  • Prospect responsiveness and engagement
  • Overall revenue contribution from inbound opportunities

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Inbound-focused sales with warm opportunities.
  • No heavy reliance on cold prospecting.
  • Direct access to property owners and real estate investors.
  • Strong relationship-driven sales environment.
  • Direct impact on client acquisition and company growth.
  • Fully remote role with significant ownership.
  • Opportunity to deepen your expertise in property management sales.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior SDR
    • Business Development Manager
    • Account Executive
    • Property Management Sales Manager
    • Sales Leadership

  • Your approach to handling inbound leads and responding quickly.
  • How you build trust with prospective clients over the phone.
  • Your approach to persistent follow-up without becoming overly aggressive.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand how you communicate with property owners, build relationships, and approach inbound sales opportunities.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have experience in property management or real estate sales.
  • Are confident speaking with property owners and investors.
  • Know how to convert warm inbound opportunities.
  • Excel at relationship-building and persistent follow-up.
  • Take ownership of your pipeline and conversions.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, performance-driven sales environments.

We’d love to hear from you.

About Edge Case:

At Edge Case, our mission is to enable the safe deployment of frontier technologies and sophisticated systems. We enable our customers to assure the safety of autonomous systems for real world deployment. We are developing products that define and measure the safety of autonomous systems. Our client base spans diverse markets such as automotive, mining, defense, insurance, and aerospace. Edge Case is founded by the recognized world leaders in autonomous system safety and autonomous vehicle safety. Our experts are writing the standards and developing the products that will bring innovation safely into society.

What You’ll Do:

As the Director of Strategic Growth – Defense Services, you will be responsible for leading strategic growth, capture, and market expansion knowledge-based services, to include high-end consulting and engineering advisory services across the Department of War (DoW), safety engineering, software-intensive systems, mission engineering, and digital engineering.

This role is focused on selling knowledge-based services that enable Executives (PAEs), Program Managers (PMs), and modernization organizations solve highly complex engineering, safety, acquisition, and technical integration challenges.

The ideal candidate possesses demonstrated success selling and capturing Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) and/or Systems Engineering & Technical Assistance (SETA) work as both a prime and subcontractor, understands the dynamics of Army contract vehicles, consortiums, and Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs), and has established relationships within Army Ground modernization communities.

This leader will position the company as a trusted advisor delivering differentiated technical consulting and knowledge-based capabilities in:

  • System Safety Engineering
  • Software Safety
  • Independent Technical Assessments
  • Mission Engineering
  • Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I)
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • Digital Engineering
  • Verification, Validation, Test & Evaluation (VV&T / T&E)
  • Safety Assurance for Autonomous and AI-enabled Systems

The Director reports to executive leadership and partners closely with operations, engineering, and human resources, to shape opportunities, influence requirements, and convert technical credibility into sustained Army growth.

Key Responsibilities:

DoW Growth & Account Strategy

  • Develop and execute growth strategies for Department of War (DoW).
  • Identify, qualify, and shape new opportunities across DoW mission areas aligned to Edge Case’s capabilities.
  • Build account plans, relationship maps, call plans, and opportunity strategies for target customers.
  • Build collaborative relationships that enhance technical solutions, proposal outcomes, and customer value.
  • Build and manage a structured capture pipeline based on quantitative research, market intelligence, federal databases, and industry trends tied to measurable growth objectives.
  • Analyze PWS/SOW/RFP requirements to identify key drivers, evaluation priorities, discriminators, and competitive positioning.
  • Move Edge Case further left of RFI/RFP by identifying customer pain points, mission needs, funding paths, and emerging requirements early.
  • Conduct competitive intelligence assessments, scorecard analyses, pricing insights, and opportunity qualification to drive informed decision-making.
  • Translate research findings and market data into actionable capture plans and early shaping strategies.
  • Support expansion into adjacent DoW markets where Edge Case capabilities are relevant.

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Ability to establish credibility quickly within operational mission environments through lived experience, mission understanding, and trusted relationships.
  • Build and maintain relationships with DoW decision-makers, acquisition leaders, program offices, mission stakeholders, and industry partners.
  • Represent Edge Case in customer meetings, industry days, conferences, and partner discussions.
  • Identify and engage partners based on capability gaps, competitive needs, and market positioning.
  • Support execution of NDAs, Teaming Agreements, and partner coordination with assistance from the Contracts team.
  • Develop and maintain strategic teaming relationships with primes, subcontractors, technology partners, and contract vehicle holders.
  • Support negotiation and development of teaming strategies that strengthen Edge Case’s competitive position.
  • Translate Edge Case’s capabilities into clear mission value for US Army acquirers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of DoD acquisition pathways, including OTAs, SBIR/STTR, and major contract vehicles.
  • Demonstrated understanding of US Army missions, operational ecosystems, acquisition pathways, and mission priorities.
  • Highly qualified solutions architect that possesses ability to comprehensively understand and clearly communicate to customers how company differentiated capabilities (SE&I, MS&A, T&E, Software Development, Digital Engineering/Acquisition, Mission Engineering, etc.) can solve their complex problems in a manner that is clearly discriminated from the competition.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be able to obtain Secret level security clearance.
  • 12-15+ years of relevant and progressive experience in federal business development, capture management, or leadership in the DoD/DoW with preferred recent emphasis on US Army Acquisition community.
  • 3 or more years of experience and proven track record developing high impact BD strategies, roadmaps, and pipelines that resulted in significant business expansion for companies like Edge Case, focused on solving complex problems of global importance in critical mission areas.
  • 3 or more years of experience collaborating with executives to prioritize resources, manage budgets, and make go/no-go decisions on gated pursuits, achieving significant organic growth. Proven track record of exceptional capture and BD performance in high-end government engineering services (A&AS and SETA) supporting missions of global importance, including rapid acquisition, mission, systems, and safety engineering, autonomous systems, advanced weapon systems, and software development.
  • Extensive experience in portfolio development, driving growth within government services through innovative solutions tailored to complex mission requirements.
  • Authorization to work in the United States is a precondition of employment. Edge Case will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa.

Why Edge Case Research?

  • Collaborative Culture: Join a dynamic, cross-functional team that values collaboration and innovation.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

Pay Rate:

The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000.00 - $180,000.00. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Edge Case considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays.

Washington state applicants only: Full-time employees accrue at least 13 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; and receive at least 96 hours for holidays.

Edge Case Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. ECR values all employees’ talents and supports an environment that is inclusive and respectful.

In this role at Webdoctor you will be responsible for the clinical assessment and safe prescribing of medicines through our platform.

.

What is the role?

You will be involved in the daily review of prescription requests from patients through our service. You will be responsible for the medical review of the patient’s application, and the prescription of medicines if the application is approved. You will also review and share clinical reports and perform other duties as agreed by the medical management team.

The role will involve reporting to our Chief Medical Officer to ensure a safe level of care for all our patients.

This is your job if you are looking for a Primary Care position which is well supported by an experienced clinical team with flexible working hours, done 100% remotely from the comfort of your own home office.

Responsibilities & Duties:

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  1. Daily review of prescription service requests through our virtual clinic.
  2. Sharing of clinical reports on our patient’s profile and answering patient messages.
  3. Safe and accurate assessment of patient requests and the prescription of medication if deemed appropriate.
  4. Escalating or flagging issues to the medical director team or management teams as necessary.
  5. To assist the clinical team with other service related duties as they arise.

What are we looking for?

  • Essential requirements:
    • A doctor currently registered with the Irish Medical Council.

Reporting into senior technology leadership, you will define and execute BCD's enterprise AI strategy, establish our AI Centre of Excellence, shape the governance and technology architecture that will underpin future innovation, and ensure AI is embedded into real operational workflows across a global organization.

This is not an optimization role. It is a build-from-zero leadership opportunity for someone who combines startup energy, enterprise leadership and deep understanding of applied AI.

The Opportunity

At BCD, we believe AI must become part of how work gets done, not simply a collection of isolated pilots.

As Head of AI, you will:

  • Set and own the enterprise AI strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned to commercial and operational priorities
  • Build and lead an AI Centre of Excellence: hire and develop engineers, solution architects, and enablement staff
  • Define standards for model selection, prompt/agent design, evaluation, and responsible-AI/risk controls; own the shared AI platform strategy (including governance of the MCP/data layer)
  • Act as the primary interface to the AI Leadership Council — reporting progress, and escalating risk or resourcing gaps
  • Establish the embedded AI champion network: recruit, train, and manage the community of practice across Product & Tech, Client Ops, Sales, Finance and People
  • Own vendor and partner relationships (model providers, platform vendors, systems integrators)

  • Champion change management and training so adoption is measured in embedded workflow change, not pilot counts
  • Enable enterprise wide engineering teams to imbed AI within the BCD suite of products, including Tripsource to deliver differentiated traveler experiences.
  • Lead development, deployment and adoption of a new, enterprise AI-SDLC framework, inclusive of internal and partner based delivery centers.

You will be accountable for transforming AI from an emerging capability into a strategic business advantage.

A Truly Global and Flexible Role

BCD operates across more than 100 countries with thousands of professionals supporting some of the world's most complex corporate travel programmes.

This role is fully remote and globally oriented.

You will work with leaders, practitioners, AI champions, technology teams and business stakeholders across multiple continents while helping define the future operating model of an AI-enabled enterprise.

A Strategic Success Role

Success in this role means:

  • Building a world-class AI Centre of Excellence
  • Embedding AI into core operational workflows

  • Increasing enterprise-wide AI adoption

Who You Are

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience required — proven ability to build new capability from zero within a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment
  • Demonstrated experience standing up or scaling a CoE, platform team, or federated operating model in a large, multi-country organization
  • Track record of translating AI initiatives into measurable productivity or revenue outcomes, not just proofs of concept
  • Strong grasp of enterprise AI governance: data privacy, model risk, responsible AI, especially in a regulated or data-sensitive context
  • Experience working with or overseeing agentic AI, LLM-based tooling, or integration frameworks (e.g., MCP)
  • Executive presence: comfortable setting strategy with C-suite and travel/operations stakeholders alike
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management capabilities

Most importantly, you know how to connect AI investment with measurable business outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to architect the future of AI at BCD
  • Executive visibility and influence
  • Global impact at enterprise scale
  • Remote-first working model
  • Ability to build your own team and operating model
  • Access to complex, high-value business challenges
  • A culture that values innovation, ownership and experimentation

Why This Role Is Different

You will define the strategy, build the capability, recruit the team, shape the platform, influence executive decisions and leave a lasting mark on how a global company operates in the age of AI.

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Industry: HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical & Home Services

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and customer-focused Customer Service & Dispatch Coordinator to support a fast-moving U.S.-based home services operation.

This is a hands-on customer service and dispatch role responsible for managing high-volume inbound communication while coordinating HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service appointments.

You’ll serve as the connection between customers and field technicians, ensuring calls are handled professionally, jobs are booked accurately, technicians are dispatched efficiently, and customers stay informed from initial inquiry through job completion.

This role is ideal for someone with direct home services dispatch experience who is comfortable managing busy phones, changing schedules, technician availability, and customer expectations simultaneously.

What You’ll Own

Customer Service & Inbound Call Management

  • Handle high-volume inbound customer interactions via phone, email, and chat.
  • Respond professionally and empathetically to service inquiries.
  • Understand customer needs and accurately capture service details.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact throughout the service process.
  • Communicate appointment confirmations, technician updates, delays, and schedule changes.
  • Handle stressed or frustrated customers calmly and professionally.
  • Follow up when necessary to ensure issues are fully resolved.

HVAC & Trades Dispatching

  • HVAC
  • Plumbing
  • Electrical
  • Other home service or skilled trades

You will:

  • Assign jobs based on technician availability, skills, location, and service requirements.
  • Maintain accurate daily and weekly dispatch calendars.
  • Monitor technician schedules and active jobs throughout the day.
  • Adjust routes and appointments in real time when emergencies, cancellations, delays, or schedule changes occur.
  • Communicate job details and updates directly with field technicians.
  • Help maximize technician utilization while maintaining a strong customer experience.

Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

  • Convert customer inquiries into accurately booked service appointments.
  • Coordinate appointment windows based on customer and technician availability.
  • Manage cancellations and rescheduling.
  • Maintain accurate calendars and prevent scheduling conflicts.
  • Prioritize urgent service requests appropriately.
  • Keep customers informed when appointment timing changes.
  • Ensure no service request or customer follow-up falls through the cracks.

ServiceTitan, CRM & Service Records

Maintain accurate customer and job information inside ServiceTitan or similar field service management platforms.

Responsibilities include:

  • Creating and updating customer records.
  • Logging calls and customer communication.
  • Entering and updating service appointments.
  • Maintaining detailed job notes.
  • Updating job and dispatch statuses.
  • Reviewing service documentation for accuracy.
  • Reviewing invoices and job records for completeness.
  • Keeping CRM and service data clean, current, and organized.

Membership & Service Plan Support

  • Explain homeowner memberships or service plans when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce relevant service plan benefits.
  • Support membership enrollment and customer retention goals.
  • Balance upselling opportunities with a customer-first service approach.

Operational Tracking & Performance Support

Track and support key operational metrics such as:

  • Call volume
  • Booking rates
  • Appointment conversion
  • Technician utilization
  • Dispatch efficiency
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Service completion

Maintain accurate records that give operations leadership clear visibility into daily performance.

Team & Technician Coordination

Work closely with:

  • Customer service representatives
  • Dispatch teams
  • HVAC, plumbing, and electrical technicians
  • Operations leadership

Maintain clear communication between office and field teams so everyone understands job assignments, customer needs, schedule changes, and operational priorities.

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 2+ years of customer service and dispatch experience within home services or skilled trades.
  • Hands-on experience scheduling and dispatching field service technicians.
  • Experience supporting industries such as:
    • HVAC
    • Plumbing
    • Electrical
    • Home services
    • Field services
  • Experience using ServiceTitan or a similar field service/CRM platform.
  • Strong experience handling customer calls in a high-volume environment.
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication.
  • Strong scheduling, organization, and multitasking skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple technicians, customers, and appointments simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and accurate documentation.
  • Comfortable working independently during U.S. EST business hours.
  • Reliable high-speed internet with audio and video capabilities.
  • Fast, reliable computer suitable for professional remote work.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Direct ServiceTitan experience.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based HVAC or home services companies.
  • Experience supporting customers in the Northeast U.S.
  • Familiarity with homeowner membership or maintenance plan upselling.
  • Experience tracking booking and dispatch KPIs.
  • Experience coordinating emergency or same-day service calls.
  • Previous experience working remotely with U.S.-based teams.
  • Experience supporting offshore or distributed teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are confident and professional on the phone.
  • Can handle a busy call queue without sacrificing customer experience.
  • Stay calm when schedules change unexpectedly.
  • Understand how field service dispatch works.
  • Communicate effectively with both customers and technicians.
  • Are comfortable making quick scheduling decisions.
  • Follow through consistently until issues are resolved.
  • Keep CRM and service records accurate.
  • Are naturally organized and process-driven.
  • Can manage frustrated customers with patience and professionalism.
  • Take ownership rather than waiting for constant direction.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A typical day may include:

  • Answering inbound customer calls, emails, and chats.
  • Booking HVAC, plumbing, or electrical service appointments.
  • Reviewing technician availability and dispatching new jobs.
  • Monitoring active service calls throughout the day.
  • Contacting customers regarding technician arrival times or delays.
  • Adjusting schedules after cancellations or emergency calls.
  • Updating ServiceTitan with customer and job information.
  • Communicating schedule changes to technicians.
  • Reviewing job notes, invoices, and service documentation.
  • Discussing membership or service plans with eligible customers.
  • Tracking booking, dispatch, and customer service metrics.

In short: you are the operational hub connecting customers with field technicians, keeping schedules efficient and ensuring every customer receives responsive, professional service.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Inbound call response and handling volume
  • Call-to-booking conversion rate
  • Scheduling accuracy
  • Technician utilization and dispatch efficiency
  • CRM and ServiceTitan data accuracy
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Speed and quality of issue resolution
  • Membership/service plan conversions
  • Timely communication of delays and schedule changes
  • Consistent follow-through on customer and technician requests

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on customer experience and daily field operations.
  • Hands-on exposure to U.S. HVAC and home services operations.
  • High ownership over scheduling and dispatch execution.
  • Opportunity to work closely with customers, technicians, and operations leadership.
  • Fully remote working environment.
  • Clear performance metrics and operational responsibilities.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Dispatcher
    • Dispatch Lead
    • Customer Service Manager
    • Service Operations Coordinator
    • Field Service Operations Manager

Interview Process

  • Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’re particularly interested in hearing about:

  • Your experience working in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home services businesses.
  • Your experience scheduling and dispatching field technicians.

  • The typical call volume and service workload you managed.

Keep your responses clear, concise, and conversational. We want to understand your communication style, home services experience, and ability to manage a fast-moving dispatch environment.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on HVAC or home services dispatch experience, are confident managing customers and technicians, and know how to keep a busy service schedule organized, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

  • Strong API design fundamentals and disciplined habits around testing, code quality, and documentation

Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or health tech background, including EHR integrations, FHIR or HL7, HIPAA, and PHI handling
  • Experience at a high-scaling technology company where reliability and throughput were mission critical

Nice to Have

  • Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS preferred), Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Redis or other caching and search layers
  • Exposure to LLM or AI product pipelines
  • Early-stage startup experience and comfort with ambiguity

Our Stack

Node.js, TypeScript, Kafka, and MongoDB, with Next.js on the front end and a purpose-built eventing engine at the core of the platform.

Job Title: Clinical Assessor - Idaho

Reports To: Corporate Director of Assessments and Referrals

Location: Remote

Licensure: Must have active, unencumbered Idaho Professional Counselor, Social Work, or Marriage and Family Therapy licensure

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Clinical Assessor will provide critical level of care assessments, individual, group, and family therapy, crisis services, case management, and referral services to outpatient clients. This person is responsible for conducting the initial assessment to determine eligibility and ensure that an initial treatment plan is developed that will identify the services and level of care needed. This position will work with other staff to ensure a smooth transition to treatment services. This person will actively communicate with support staff, treatment teams, and outside agencies on treatment and safety issues pertaining to clients and their family members. The Clinical Assessor will complete all documentation associated with these duties in a professional and timely manner.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

  • Conduct confidential substance use and mental health assessments in person or telehealth to determine the need and level of care for clients
  • Make placement to appropriate facility based on the outcome of the assessment interview
  • Use a strengths-based and trauma-informed approach to work collaboratively with clients and internal treatment team members to help support clients in their treatment goals
  • Provide clinical consultation to referral resources, family members, and others to help support clients in their treatment goals
  • Work closely with clients to engage them in the decision-making process and help them understand the benefits of assessment and accessing the appropriate level of care as indicated
  • Collect and review referral information upon assignment of clients from the referral source and consult with others as needed to support coordination of services and scheduling of client assessments
  • Coordinate with Admissions, front desk team members, and other staff as needed to contact clients and guardians to confirm appointment dates, times, and assessment locations
  • Collect information from collateral resources to aid in determining diagnosis and need for treatment
  • Based on assessments, make referrals to the most appropriate programs and agencies to help clients access the right level of care to best meet their treatment needs
  • Monitor client access to and involvement with the program to help address barriers to treatment; follow up with client and guardian timely to assess satisfaction with adjusting to the program
  • Model and support health and wellness activities and healthy coping skills for clients
  • If client is admitted to one of Northpoint’s facilities, coordinate the admission and intake with the appropriate staff to ensure a timely and smooth transition into treatment; if client is referred to a program of another agency, forward all requested documentation with proper approval
  • Work collaboratively with client’s funding sources and Northpoint’s Utilization Review team to obtain initial authorizations for reimbursement for treatment and support services
  • Work cooperatively with the legal system to ensure coordination of services including Court appearances when appropriate
  • Complete paperwork requirements and maintain quality, up-to-date clinical records, including Outcomes Survey information and information for billing; enter necessary information into the electronic medical records (EMR) system
  • Maintain working knowledge of other agencies and programs and a list of resources that can be shared with clients and their guardians
  • Remain in compliance with internal and external policies, procedures, regulations, and standards
  • Participate in all assigned meetings, staff development, and training as required
  • Provide back-up assistance to Counselors with group and individual therapy sessions as necessary
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures
  • Maintain confidentiality in accordance with established policies and procedures and standards of care
  • Other clinically appropriate services and special projects as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

  • Master’s Degree in Mental Health, Social Sciences or other relevant field required
  • Active mental health licensure in the state where treatment services are rendered required
  • If substance use licensure is not active, must be willing to apply for substance use licensure
  • Must maintain applicable state licensure requirements at hire and for the entire duration of employment
  • 1+ year of experience in relevant field that clearly demonstrates knowledge and skills related to the treatment of mental health disorders
  • Must be able to exercise discretion and independent judgment in all areas of job performance including adherence to appropriate professional boundaries and strict confidentiality practices in regard to client activities and documentation
  • Experience with trauma-informed services, cognitive behavioral therapies including DBT, CBT, and motivational therapies
  • Able to apply clinical judgment, ethics and accountability to formulate and implement treatment plans and other clinical documentation
  • Ability to work with a diverse population and possess strong interpersonal skills and knowledge required for treating adolescent clients assigned
  • Must hold strong personal boundaries and able to build rapport with patients
  • Must understand and adhere to the ethical standards of the respective licensure governing board

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Excellent organizational abilities
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Client service oriented (both internal and external)
  • Creative and persistent problem solver
  • Able to handle confidential material in a reliable manner
  • Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of organization
  • Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive situations and confidential information
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and EMR systems

FULL-TIME BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Subsidized Health Insurance Coverage for Employee, Spouse, & Dependent(s)
  • 100% Employer Paid Basic Life Insurance equal to 1x annual salary, up to $100,000
  • 100% Employer Paid Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Supplemental Life & AD&D, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance.
  • Pre-tax Savings Accounts for all IRS-allowable medical and dependent care expenses
  • Generous Paid Time Off plan

This is a pro-bono volunteer position.

JerseySTEM is seeking a member to standardize and operate our Gemini AI productivity stack using Google Gemini to collaborate and communicate across our fully remote, member-driven organization.

Job Function: Channel

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

This quota-carrying role will own Keyfactor’s marketplace go-to-market strategy with Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure, while developing new routes to market through strategic ISV ecosystems, initially including CrowdStrike and ServiceNow.

The Senior Manager will convert these relationships into measurable marketplace revenue, qualified pipeline, new customer acquisition and faster sales cycles. The role will also help customers purchase Keyfactor through the technology providers, marketplaces and committed cloud-spend programs they already use.

Success requires a combination of alliance leadership, marketplace expertise, field sales collaboration and hands-on deal execution.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

Marketplace Strategy and Revenue

  • Own and execute Keyfactor’s growth strategy across AWS Marketplace, Microsoft commercial marketplace and selected strategic ISV marketplaces.
  • Develop business plans with measurable revenue, pipeline, co-sell, enablement, funding, campaign and event objectives.
  • Achieve and maintain the strongest relevant standing and designations within the AWS Partner Network and Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program.

Hyperscaler and ISV Alliances

  • Build relationships across ISV alliance, product, marketplace, marketing, sales, channel and executive teams.

Field and Transaction Execution

  • Work directly with Keyfactor sales leaders and account executives to identify marketplace opportunities across new customers, existing accounts, renewals and expansions.
  • Engage early to assess committed cloud spend, marketplace preferences, available funding and strategic technology relationships.
  • Lead account mapping and co-sell execution across Keyfactor, hyperscaler sellers, ISV teams, Channel Account Managers and Strategic Partners.
  • Remove alliance and marketplace blockers and coordinate the parties required to advance and close transactions.
  • Create or direct private offers through AWS and Microsoft marketplaces, working with Sales, Channel, Finance, Legal, Operations and Deal Desk to validate pricing, partner economics, terms, billing and customer acceptance.
  • Operationalize applicable transaction, referral, co-sell and lead-management processes within selected ISV marketplaces.

Enablement and Operational Scale

  • Prepare Keyfactor’s Strategic Partners to transact through AWS Channel Partner Private Offers, Microsoft multiparty private offers and other partner-led marketplace routes.
  • Create scalable playbooks, qualification guidance, seller training, engagement processes and deal-support resources.
  • Serve as Keyfactor’s internal subject-matter expert and escalation point for cloud co-sell, marketplace funding, private offers and ISV marketplace opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, alliance-influence and transaction data in Salesforce and applicable partner platforms.
  • Collaborate with Field Marketing, Channel Marketing, Sales Engineering, Finance, Operations and Legal to develop campaigns, commercial models and routes to market.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in strategic alliances, cloud partnerships, marketplace sales, business development, channel sales or enterprise software sales.
  • 3+ years of direct experience developing go-to-market relationships with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience working within AWS or Microsoft, or leading hyperscaler partnerships for an enterprise software or cybersecurity ISV.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Marketplace, AWS Partner Central, ACE, AWS ISV Accelerate, private offers and Channel Partner Private Offers.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Partner Center, Microsoft co-sell, Azure IP co-sell, MACC-aligned transactions, private offers and multiparty private offers.
  • Experience developing joint go-to-market motions with enterprise ISVs through account mapping, field enablement, referrals, co-marketing and marketplace pipeline development.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, cloud security, digital trust, machine identity security, PKI or cryptographic technologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.

  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Patient Engagement Specialist, you are responsible for supporting both patients and clinical care team members with engagement efforts. Patient Engagement Specialists will play a critical role in ensuring that patients achieve initial activation and ongoing engagement with Evergreen Nephrology and their local care teams. The Patient Engagement Teamwill partner with our market operations teams across the US to ensure patients are actively engaging in their care, working with their interdisciplinary care team, and achieving their kidney care and overall care goals. While this position is fully remote, you will support patients in all time zones Monday-Friday 8:30a-5p (CST preferred).

  • Work in collaboration with interdisciplinary care team members (nephrologist, practice staff, nurse care managers, advanced practice providers, social workers, and dieticians)
  • Assist with patient and practice administrative requests such as new patient onboarding outreach, connection to their local care team, scheduling assistance, intake of patient complaints, and other needs
  • Assist with building new workflows, processes, and documentation related to contact center operations

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Operations team is looking for an experienced fraud analyst to join an industry-leading global fraud operations team. This position is responsible for writing and maintaining fraud rulesets to prevent transaction fraud, conducting data analysis to identify and mitigate fraud attacks, while minimizing impact to users, and working collaboratively with fraud, operations, and product stakeholders to proactively implement fraud strategies and controls. They should have a deep understanding of fraud patterns and typologies, advanced SQL proficiency, strong analytical abilities, and experience writing and managing fraud rulesets.

What you'll do

Did you know that only around 4% of the world's GDP comes from internet commerce? At Stripe, we believe that this represents a future with almost limitless potential for innovation, creativity, and global prosperity. While the promise of a global online economy is palpable, it doesn't come without significant risk. Each day, bad actors disrupt the trust and safety of the internet and increase the barrier of entry for online businesses. Before we can fully realize the potential of a global internet economy, we must first address the burgeoning problem of fraud.

We are looking for someone passionate about fighting fraud, identifying new trends and typologies, conducting complex data analysis, and working collaboratively with peers and partners in the fraud space. This position works closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, data science, and operations to identify and mitigate risk from complex, distributed transaction fraud attacks.

The right candidate for this role will have a minimum of five years' experience conducting advanced data analysis using SQL, preferably within the fraud space across e-commerce, payments, or cryptocurrency. Candidates should have experience writing, maintaining, and analyzing complex fraud rulesets and demonstrated success minimizing fraud losses along with impacts to users. Candidates should also have experience working closely with product teams to implement risk controls and demonstrate a deep understanding of fraud typologies, controls, and ability to mitigate fraud risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain fraud rulesets to prevent transaction-level fraud losses, including ongoing monitoring and measurements of precision and recall
  • Conduct advanced data analysis of structured and unstructured data sets to proactively identify emerging fraud attacks impacting Stripe and its users
  • Collaborate closely with product, risk, and operations teams to proactively identify and mitigate fraud exposure
  • Investigate, conduct root cause analysis, and deploy remediations to prevent future complex and distributed fraud attacks
  • Investigate and take action against anomalous clusters of transactions based on account activity, processing volume, or other risk indicators while minimizing negative impacts to Stripe users
  • Respond to incidents involving complex fraud schemes to quickly mitigate exposure to Stripe, its users, and financial partners
  • Utilize analytics to identify and implement initiatives to automate manual processes and workload across the organization
  • Create visualizations, dashboards, and queries to drive visibility and oversight into impact, performance, loss risks, and user experience
  • Utilize Stripe tools and systems to enable systematic actioning of fraudulent merchants, maintaining an extremely high level of accuracy to prevent negative user experience

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A minimum of five years of experience conducting advanced data analysis and managing transaction fraud rulesets
  • Advanced-level proficiency in SQL
  • Experience working closely with modeling, data science, and intelligence stakeholders to implement automatic and scaled controls and processes
  • Experience creating data visualizations and dashboards and presenting findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
  • The ability to drive execution on projects working in a heavily cross-functional environment
  • Creativity, a team-focused mentality, and effective problem-solving skills
  • The ability and desire to question the status quo
  • The ability to approach challenges from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented

Preferred qualifications

  • Fraud experience in payments, e-commerce, fintechs, or cryptocurrency mitigating digital and card-not-present fraud
  • Experience investigating and mitigating card testing and account takeover attacks
  • Proficiency in Splunk, Python, Tableau, or other data visualization tools
  • Undergraduate or advanced degree in analytics, data science, or statistics
  • Experience with clustering, classification, and link analysis
  • Experience working in fast-paced and rapidly changing environments
  • Experience designing and implementing product-level fraud and risk controls

As a Sr. Customer Enablement Practitioner, you will provide deep domain expertise when a Technical Success Manager (TSM) identifies a complex customer need. Engagements range from targeted consultations and health checks to AI workflow design and optimization programs. These projects have specific scopes, costs, and timelines. While the TSM manages the overall customer relationship, you will lead the technical engagement from start to finish.

To succeed in this role you must have experience in:

  • Professional Experience: Minimum 8 years of hands-on technical work in voice network engineering, post-sales, professional services, or solutions engineering — with direct voice network design and implementation responsibility. Experience on the vendor side or enterprise/client side in a hands-on voice network engineering capacity.

  • Technical Core: Personal ownership of voice network architecture for enterprise environments — able to walk through the call flow, SIP trunk configuration, failure modes, QoS/automation scripting, and design tradeoffs.

  • Protocol & Network Mastery: Protocol fluency: has configured SIP, RTP, QoS, and codecs, read vendor documentation critically, debugged call quality and routing failures, and designed failover/redundancy logic. Demonstrated scripting/automation capability with tools like Python, Ansible, or equivalent voice/network automation platforms.

  • Platform Expertise: SBC or SD-WAN experience: has designed or assessed a session border controller, SD-WAN, or equivalent voice-aware network deployment in a production context. Has personally responded to voice outages or call quality degradation in production and recovered them — can describe what broke, the diagnostic process, and the fix.

  • Migrations & Delivery: Implemented a PBX-to-cloud or SIP trunking migration end-to-end — including dial plan design, carrier configuration, and go-live support.

  • Certifications: Relevant platform certifications strongly preferred: Cisco (CCNP Collaboration/CCIE Collaboration), Avaya, Microsoft Teams Voice, RingCentral certifications, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent.

  • Verifiable Track Record: Documented professional history detailing deployment scopes, past employers, systems touched, mistakes learned from, and outcomes delivered that a technical interviewer can interrogate.

Job Responsibilities:

Customer Engagements

  • Specialized Resource: Engage as a pull-in specialist when the TSM identifies a customer need requiring domain depth — complex configuration, voice network architecture, advanced feature adoption, or platform optimization.

  • Strategic Workshops & Migrations: Run technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders to scope new voice projects, gather requirements (call flows, extensions, integrations), set realistic implementation timelines, and lead voice network migrations and cutovers (including PBX-to-cloud and carrier transitions) with rollback plans.

  • Platform Health & Capacity Checks: Conduct voice network capacity planning, performance analysis, and security hardening assessments (including SBC configuration, toll fraud prevention, and failover/disaster recovery design) to size bandwidth and identify bottlenecks.

  • Technical Consultation & Troubleshooting: Design and architect enterprise voice network solutions (SIP trunking, QoS, PBX/UCaaS connectivity), configure QoS policies, VLANs, firewall/SBC rules, troubleshoot root cause voice quality/routing issues (jitter, latency, packet loss, codec mismatches), and serve as the technical escalation point for complex issues.

Document voice network topologies, dial plans, and configurations for customer handoff, and provide go-live support and post-implementation stabilization.

  • Gap Documentation: Document recurring product gaps, configuration limitations, and customer-requested capabilities observed across engagements.

  • Feedback Integration: Submit structured input through the SME-to-Product feedback channel after each engagement.

  • Beta Participation: Participate in product beta programs and early access initiatives within your specialty lane.

Internal Knowledge

  • Knowledge Contribution: Contribute to all knowledge resources for RingCentral teams.

  • Competitive Analysis: Stay current on competitive platform capabilities (NICE CXone, Genesys, Five9, Zoom) within your domain.

How You Work

  • Exceptional Communication: You communicate with a professional, cordial, and personable demeanor in all interactions.

  • Ownership and Accountability: You take full responsibility for your tasks and communication, ensuring complete follow-through and timely delivery.

  • Precision: You provide direct and specific technical communication, avoiding ambiguity and maintaining clarity on complex topics.

  • Resilience Under Pressure: You remain credible and composed when navigating technical challenges with sophisticated customers or internal stakeholders.

  • Operational Efficiency: You scope engagements with clarity and produce high-quality deliverables that require minimal revision.

  • Technical Excellence: You focus on technical unimpeachability and preparedness, serving as the subject matter expert while the TSM manages the primary relationship.

And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.

RingCentral is a global leader in agentic voice AI–powered business communications, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. In 2013, Future Caucus organized the nation's first and only caucus for young members of Congress, the Congressional Future Caucus, to build coalitions on future-oriented challenges. Future Caucus also scaled this model into 36 state legislatures, each with a Future Caucus consisting of young, high-potential legislators, and has engaged more than 2,100 young legislators nationwide. In 2025, Future Caucus' President & CEO was named to the TIME100 Next list. Learn more at .

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Contributing Writer will own the editorial pipeline for Future Caucus' Young Lawmakers' Storybank, a curated database of stories about young legislators governing effectively and a vital tool for helping target audiences connect with the impact of Gen Z and millennial lawmakers across the country. They will report directly to the Senior Director, Communications.

This individual will serve as the Storybank's primary journalist, responsible for the full life cycle of each article: identifying and pursuing story leads, conducting interviews with Future Caucus members from both parties, and writing and editing reported articles of approximately 800-1,000 words on a biweekly publication schedule. Story formats include legislative deep dives ("Anatomy of a Bill"), cross-state policy roundups, profiles of effective lawmakers, and event coverage. The Contributing Writer will coordinate with the Communications team on editorial priorities and with program staff to surface leads from across the Future Caucus network.

The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist or features writer who can run a story from pitch to publication with minimal editorial oversight — sourcing their own leads, conducting interviews with elected officials, and delivering clean, fact-checked, publication-ready copy on deadline. Fluency in state and federal politics and a genuine ability to write about lawmakers of both parties with fairness and curiosity are essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research, report, write, and edit narrative Storybank articles on a biweekly publication schedule (approximately 12-13 articles over the contract term)
  • Identify and pitch story leads by reviewing Future Caucus video content and internal policy tracking, monitoring state and local news coverage, legislative activity, and social media across the Future Caucus network, and by coordinating with staff on legislative victories, events, and member milestones
  • Propose, schedule, and conduct interviews with young state and federal lawmakers from both parties
  • Manage each article through the full production cycle: pitch, first draft, editorial revisions, lawmaker review, and publication, in coordination with the Senior Director, Communications
  • Maintain the Storybank editorial tracker with story status, sources, and publication timelines
  • Write across the Storybank's established content streams — including Anatomy of a Bill, Policy Impacts, Profiles of Effective Lawmakers, and event recaps — matching their tone, structure, and balance of quotes and interpretation
  • Fact-check all articles and ensure adherence to AP style and Future Caucus editorial and brand guidelines
  • Flag standout quotes, moments, and visuals to the digital content team for social media amplification
  • Be available for editorial check-ins, edits, and interview scheduling during core hours (12-4 p.m. ET)
  • Perform other related duties as needed

Requirements

ABOUT YOU

  • 3+ years of professional experience in features, narrative, or storytelling-driven writing, whether as a journalist, features writer, newsletter or blog author, or ghostwriter; a state or local politics beat is a strong plus. A traditional newsroom background is welcome but not required
  • Demonstrated experience conducting interviews for published work and drawing out compelling quotes and anecdotes; experience interviewing elected officials, candidates, or other public figures is a strong plus
  • A portfolio of writing — published articles, newsletter or blog posts, or ghostwritten work — showing your ability to turn reporting into engaging, narrative-driven stories
  • A track record of taking writing projects from concept to publication independently, with clean copy that requires minimal editing
  • Strong command of AP style, or a demonstrated ability to write cleanly and consistently within a house style guide
  • Deep interest in and working knowledge of U.S. politics at the state and federal level
  • Ability to write about Republican and Democratic lawmakers with equal fairness, accuracy, and curiosity
  • Self-directed and highly organized: you manage your own pipeline, hit deadlines without prompting, and communicate proactively
  • Ability to maintain the highest degree of confidentiality and integrity in working with lawmakers and their staff
  • Passion for bipartisan cooperation and cross-partisan dialogue

OUR VALUES

In 2020, Future Caucus unveiled a set of organizational value statements developed collaboratively by our team. This ethos represents what we believe in at Future Caucus, and what we have worked to establish during the last 11 years. These are the values we have set for ourselves, and what we see come to life through our legislators in our network, partners, and supporters:

  • Listen First: communicate openly and respectfully — make room for others at the table
  • Say "We": there is no "I" in Future Caucus — welcome diversity; it makes us stronger
  • Build Trust: Integrity in our relationships is fundamental — be reliable and follow through
  • Empower Others: Be empathetic — practice transparency and collaborate openly
  • Break Barriers: Climb it, go through it, or work around it — limits are challenges to overcome
  • Innovate Freely: Disruption leads to creative solutions — forge a new path forward

LOCATION & SCHEDULE

This is a remote contract position. While the position prioritizes deliverables over set working hours, the contractor is expected to be available for editorial check-ins, edits, and other consultations during core hours of 12-4 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday. Interviews with lawmakers may occasionally require flexibility around legislators' schedules.

Benefits

COMPENSATION

This is a six-month contract compensated at $2,500 per month for approximately 10-15 hours of work per week. The contract may be extended by mutual agreement, though extension is not guaranteed. This is an independent contractor position; the contractor is responsible for their own taxes and benefits.

HIRING PROCESS

The priority deadline for this role is August 23, 2026 and we anticipate communicating to all candidates following our priority deadline. Applications received after this date will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

Applicants should submit a resume and three to five published clips, ideally including political features or reported profiles.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

As an equal opportunity employer, Future Caucus is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We welcome members of historically underrepresented groups to apply, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and multilingual individuals. Reference checks are conducted on all prospective new hires.

About Health Advocate

Health Advocate is a trusted healthcare advocacy and assistance company dedicated to helping people navigate the healthcare system and improve their overall well-being. Every day, our teams support members through complex healthcare, mental health, and work-life challenges while delivering exceptional service and measurable outcomes.

We are seeking a Compliance & Quality Program Coordinator to support regulatory compliance, grievance administration, quality improvement initiatives, and accreditation activities within our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems, managing regulatory processes, and partnering across teams to improve quality and compliance outcomes.

What You'll Do

As the Compliance & Quality Program Coordinator, you will play a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance, supporting audit readiness, overseeing grievance processes, and coordinating quality improvement activities. You'll work closely with clinical leadership, operations, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to identify risks, ensure regulatory adherence, and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Coordinate regulatory reporting, documentation, filing requirements, and compliance calendars associated with the Knox-Keene license.
  • Monitor regulatory and legislative updates and communicate impacts to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Support audit readiness efforts, including documentation collection, evidence preparation, and regulatory follow-up activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of filings, inquiries, corrective actions, and regulatory commitments.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and recommend appropriate actions or escalations.

Grievance Administration & Resolution

  • Monitor grievances from intake through closure, ensuring accurate tracking, documentation, investigation, and timely resolution.
  • Conduct investigations and manage non-clinical grievance communications.
  • Collaborate with clinical leadership on grievances requiring clinical review.
  • Prepare compliant grievance correspondence and maintain complete case documentation.
  • Analyze grievance trends and recommend process improvements, training opportunities, and corrective actions.

Compliance & Quality Program Coordination

  • Coordinate day-to-day activities supporting compliance, grievance, and quality programs.
  • Maintain workplans, dashboards, tracking tools, action-item logs, and regulatory calendars.
  • Monitor deadlines, dependencies, and potential risks while escalating concerns as needed.
  • Prepare materials and documentation for compliance and quality meetings.
  • Provide leadership with updates regarding compliance activities, grievance trends, and quality initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Training

  • Serve as a liaison among clinical leadership, operational teams, legal counsel, Provider Relations, and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with teams to improve reporting processes, documentation standards, and workflow efficiency.
  • Assist with training and education related to compliance, audit, grievance, and reporting requirements.
  • Support accreditation and compliance initiatives across multiple business areas as needed.

Quality Improvement

  • Analyze compliance, grievance, and service-related data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support root cause analysis activities and track corrective and preventive actions through completion.
  • Monitor improvement initiatives and communicate progress, outcomes, and risks to leadership.
  • Contribute to ongoing efforts that improve member experience, service quality, and regulatory readiness.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, regulated healthcare operations, grievance administration, quality improvement, accreditation support, licensing, or a related field.
  • Experience coordinating investigations, grievances, audit readiness activities, or corrective action processes.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with business technology and reporting tools such as Excel, Salesforce, case management systems, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Knox-Keene Health Care Service Plan Act, DMHC requirements, CMS programs, Medicare, Medicaid managed care, or similar regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience supporting regulatory filings, accreditation reviews, audits, or ongoing compliance readiness efforts.
  • Experience investigating or managing healthcare grievances, service complaints, or quality concerns.
  • Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.
  • Experience improving operational processes to enhance compliance, efficiency, and consistency.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate demonstrates:

  • Strong attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Excellent project and time management
  • Ability to influence and collaborate across teams
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment

Physical Requirements:

This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.

Mental and Cognitive Requirements:

The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.

Work Environment:

This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

We’re on a mission to change the tire industry — how it’s delivered and how it’s experienced.
