Job purpose

The Controller – Corporate Accounting leads BELAY's Corporate Accounting function and is responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of the organization's financial reporting and accounting operations. This role oversees the Corporate Accounting Team, manages the monthly close process, ensures compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and partners closely with Finance leadership to support budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and strategic decision-making.

The Controller serves as a trusted financial leader, driving operational excellence, strengthening internal controls, and continuously improving accounting processes to support the organization's long-term success.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate Accounting Team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance coaching, and professional development conversations with direct reports.
  • Plan, prioritize, and delegate work assignments while providing technical guidance and removing barriers to team success.
  • Establish and monitor departmental goals, key metrics, and performance expectations.
  • Provide recommendations for process improvements, technology enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance on strategic initiatives and departmental planning.

Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

  • Oversee the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of income, expenses, and financial transactions.
  • Ensure timely reconciliation of balance sheet accounts and review monthly account reconciliations.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including maintaining close calendars and reporting deadlines.
  • Monitor working capital accounts, including cash, receivables, payables, accrued liabilities, and fixed assets.
  • Prepare and compile monthly financial statements for leadership and shareholder reporting.
  • Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analyses.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and BELAY accounting policies.
  • Oversee annual external audits and coordinate audit documentation and support.
  • Maintain the integrity of accounting systems, financial data, and related system integrations.
  • Strengthen internal controls and identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency.

Cash Management & Business Partnership

  • Monitor daily cash position and organizational liquidity.
  • Partner with FP&A to support forecasting, planning, and financial analysis.
  • Provide accounting guidance and technical expertise to operational leaders.
  • Partner with system administrators to implement system enhancements and improve accounting workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive accounting experience with prior leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience managing general ledger accounting, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close processes.
  • Strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • Experience leading accounting operations and improving financial processes.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to coach, develop, and manage a high-performing team.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of integrity and ability to manage confidential financial information.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA designation.
  • Experience leading external audits.
  • Experience with ERP or cloud-based accounting systems.
  • Experience working in a remote or distributed organization.
  • Experience supporting budgeting and financial planning processes.

Skills & Competencies

  • Financial reporting and accounting expertise.
  • Leadership and people development.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.
  • Analytical and critical thinking.
  • Process improvement and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Project and time management.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and decision-making.

Working Conditions

BELAY is a remote-first organization. This role requires a dedicated home office, regular use of virtual collaboration tools, and a work schedule that aligns with business needs and BELAY's core collaboration hours. Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent participation in virtual meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, email, and phone.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Direct Reports

  • Corporate Accountant(s)
  • Accounts Payable Specialist

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

$87,000 - $92,000

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon.

jobs.description:
Help Us Make Homeownership Easier to Reach
We specialize in helping qualified homebuyers explore pathways to homeownership, including programs that may make purchasing a home possible with little to no money down and little to no funds needed for closing costs through select proprietary portfolio loan products.

We need assistance with the buyers that are reaching out to us to learn how to become a homeowner.

We’re seeking experienced, licensed Mortgage Loan Officers who share our commitment to simplifying the mortgage process and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

You May Be a Great Fit If You Love:

  • Helping people understand what it takes to become homeowners
  • Reviewing income, credit, assets, and documentation
  • Finding solutions for borrowers who may not fit inside a standard lending box
  • Structuring loans and comparing available financing options
  • Paying close attention to details and anticipating potential obstacles
  • Following up consistently and moving borrowers toward the next step
  • Keeping borrowers, real estate agents, and transaction partners informed
  • Turning a complicated process into a clear, understandable plan
  • Creating the kind of experience that produces raving fans and referrals

What You’ll Do

  • Meet with prospective homebuyers and assess their financing needs
  • Educate borrowers about available loan and homebuyer-assistance options
  • Collect and review financial information and supporting documentation
  • Structure appropriate loan scenarios based on each borrower’s circumstances
  • Guide borrowers from the initial conversation through application, pre-approval, and closing
  • Maintain accurate notes, records, and follow-up activities
  • Proactively communicate with borrowers, agents, processors, and other transaction partners
  • Provide responsive, professional service throughout the entire mortgage process
  • Follow all company policies and applicable federal and state lending regulations

Required Qualifications

  • Active Mortgage Loan Originator license and NMLS registration
  • Previous mortgage origination experience
  • Working knowledge of mortgage guidelines, income calculations, credit, assets, and loan structuring
  • Strong customer-service and communication skills
  • Exceptional organization, follow-up, and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple borrowers and transactions in a remote environment
  • Comfortable using mortgage technology, CRM systems, video meetings, email, and phone communication
  • A genuine desire to help more people successfully become homeowners

Position Details

  • Remote position
  • Experienced, licensed loan officers only
  • Additional state licenses may be required based on assigned markets
  • Compensation: base plus bonus depending on experience.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a position for someone who simply wants to quote rates and take applications. We’re looking for loan officers who enjoy solving problems, building trust, communicating clearly, and helping borrowers accomplish something meaningful.

Our mission is to unlock and simplify homeownership. If your definition of a successful day is helping people move forward while creating an experience they’ll enthusiastically recommend to others, we’d love to speak with you.

Apply Today!

  • Has the ability to directly supervise personnel.

jobs.excerpt: Introduction WaterConnect LLC (“WaterConnect”) is a project development company dedicated to creating opportunities for construction-stage investment in water supply and sanitation (WSS) infrastructure in low- and middle-income countries.
jobs.description:
Introduction

WaterConnect LLC (“WaterConnect”) is a project development company dedicated to creating opportunities for construction-stage investment in water supply and sanitation (WSS) infrastructure in low- and middle-income countries. We bring early-stage financing and technical expertise to complement local partners, develop new infrastructure, and deploy technology that will impact water access, quality, and scarcity, and in turn build resilience for households and watersheds.

WaterConnect partners with infrastructure developers, utilities, engineering firms, technology providers and equipment suppliers to co-develop infrastructure projects, bringing them from concept to financial close and construction. With the goal of accelerating the flow of projects, WaterConnect offers project development funding and expertise, particularly in legal and financial structuring, capital raising, and social and environmental impact, to supplement the pre-existing resources of project co-developers. WaterConnect seeks to develop a range of water projects, including both public private partnership projects for municipal infrastructure, as well as private industrial projects that mitigate water scarcity and reduce wastewater discharges. WaterConnect coordinates closely with sister organizations, Water.org and WaterEquity, which offer complementary products, including private equity and construction-stage infrastructure project financing.

WaterConnect is in its third year of operations after spinning off from Water.org in 2024. It represents the latest in a series of innovations by Water.org to catalyze investment into water supply and sanitation in pursuit of achieving access for all, as highlighted by UN Sustainable Development Goal 6.

Summary

WaterConnect is seeking a meticulous, self-motivated Finance and Accounting Manager to safeguard and strengthen the financial foundation of a high-impact, fast-growing infrastructure investment platform. This is an opportunity to join a startup company backed by a larger global group, working at the intersection of treasury, accounting, and reporting for a mission-driven organization.

The Finance and Accounting Manager oversees WaterConnect's internal financial operations, ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant management of the organization's finances. This role is responsible for treasury and liquidity management, vendor and banking relationships, and financial reporting. It also oversees sound accounting procedures and controls, manages the day-to-day and period-end close process, and ensures compliance with applicable accounting and tax regulations.

Working closely with Water.org's finance team, the Finance and Accounting Manager will play a key role in financial statement consolidation and in maintaining the financial integrity that supports WaterConnect's mission. The role offers significant visibility, a direct line to management, and the chance to grow with the company.

Job Responsibilities

Internal Financial Services

  • Oversee bank accounts and payments to vendors, projects, intercompanies, payroll, and reimbursements
  • Oversee liquidity management and reserve balances, including cash flow monitoring and forecasting
  • Manage relationships with banking partners, auditors, and tax advisors
  • Prepare and deliver financial reports and forecasts for management, the parent company, and governing bodies

Accounting and Controls

  • Oversee accounting, including day-to-day and period-end closing processes, in partnership with a third-party accounting provider
  • Establish and enforce proper finance and accounting procedures and controls, including capitalization of project expenses
  • Lead aspects of finance department collaboration with the parent company, including consolidation
  • Prepare annual tax filings and ensure compliance with applicable accounting and tax regulations
  • Support the annual external audit process and respond to auditor requests
  • Monitor and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances to support accurate consolidation

How to Apply

Submit a cover letter with salary requirements and a resume. Both documents must be in English.

WaterConnect is an equal-opportunity employer. WaterConnect recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

Don't meet every single requirement? If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience does not perfectly match every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Your unique skills and perspective could make you the ideal candidate for this position.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 5 or more years of progressive experience in accounting and finance roles, including treasury, financial reporting, and the accounting close process
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CPA, CMA, CA, ACCA) or equivalent demonstrated expertise
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS, with experience supporting multi-entity or parent-subsidiary consolidation
  • Experience managing banking relationships, treasury operations, and liquidity or cash management
  • Experience working with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory bodies; familiarity with international tax compliance considerations
  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and enforce sound accounting procedures and internal controls
  • Proficiency with accounting software or ERP systems and advanced Excel skills
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, virtual team in a hands-on role
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, multicultural teams
  • Demonstrated commitment to social and environmental impact
  • Proficient (written and verbal) in English

Preferred:

  • Experience in infrastructure finance
  • Experience with international transactions, multi-currency accounting, and reporting across international entities

Physical Requirements:

Role includes regular online collaboration across time zones. Colleagues, partners, and service providers are based in the Americas, Africa, India, and East Asia. While the role is fully remote, to ensure real-time overlap with the President and Water.org’s finance team during core business hours, we require candidates to be based in the Eastern or Central time zone. This role involves extended periods of sitting and reaching. This role requires the ability to see, talk, and hear. Travel may be required up to 10% of the time.

Benefits

This position offers full-time benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible spending plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) plan, and periodic review for merit and incentive pay based on organizational and personal achievement. Overall compensation will be commensurate with education and experience and structured to reflect a competitive package for a full-time team member.

Expected pay range is $80,000 to 110,000 per year.

No relocation benefits, work permit reimbursement, or visa sponsorship will be offered.

Vālenz® Health is the platform to simplify healthcare – the destination for employers, payers, providers and members to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. The Valenz mindset and culture of innovation combine to create a distinctly different approach to an inefficient, uninspired health system. With fully integrated solutions, Valenz engages early and often to execute across the entire patient journey – from care navigation and management to payment integrity, plan performance and provider verification. With a 99% client retention rate, we elevate expectations to a new level of efficiency, effectiveness and transparency where smarter, better, faster healthcare is possible.

About This Opportunity: As the VP, Bill Review Operations, you will lead the Bill Review Services organization, setting operational priorities and ensuring successful execution of business objectives in partnership with the EVP, Payment Integrity. You will oversee the operational and financial performance of the organization while building and developing a high-performing leadership team and creating an environment of accountability, collaboration, sound decision-making, and operational excellence.
In this role, you’ll balance client needs, financial performance, operational outcomes, and growth priorities while partnering across the organization to remove barriers, strengthen capabilities, and position Bill Review Services for scalable, sustainable success.

Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Lead the Bill Review Services organization with accountability for operational performance, service delivery, financial results, and achievement of departmental objectives.
  • Partner with the EVP, Payment Integrity to establish strategic direction, annual operating priorities, and long-term growth plans for Bill Review Services.
  • Set organizational priorities and make strategic decisions around resources, structure, capacity, and business tradeoffs to optimize performance and support growth.
  • Lead, coach, and develop senior leaders, establishing clear expectations and accountability for operational, financial, quality, and client outcomes.
  • Build a high-performing leadership culture centered on ownership, collaboration, sound decision-making, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the operational and financial health of Bill Review Services through regular review of key performance indicators, service levels, quality outcomes, budgets, and other measures of organizational performance.
  • Drive execution of strategic initiatives by aligning leaders and resources, resolving competing priorities, removing barriers, and maintaining accountability for results.
  • Partner with executive and cross-functional leaders to align operational strategy with organizational priorities, client commitments, technology initiatives, and business growth.
  • Anticipate operational risks, capacity constraints, and emerging business needs, developing strategies that strengthen performance and support sustainable growth.
  • Build organizational capability through succession planning, leadership development, workforce planning, and organizational design.
  • Serve as the executive operational leader for Bill Review Services in client executive meetings, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional leadership discussions.
  • Champion operational excellence by empowering leaders to solve complex business challenges, identify opportunities, and continuously improve organizational performance.
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, payment integrity, revenue cycle, bill review, managed care, or a related operational environment.
  • 5+ years of senior leadership experience leading multiple functions through Directors or other senior leaders.
  • Proven success leading complex operations through growth, transformation, or organizational scaling while driving strong operational and financial performance.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with experience using performance metrics and data to set priorities, make decisions, and improve results.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and hold high-performing leadership teams accountable.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions and with senior stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field.
A plus if you have:
  • Experience in payment integrity, bill review, claims processing, workers’ compensation, group health, or related healthcare services.
  • Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or similar).

Where You’ll Work:This is a fully remote position, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!
  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Valenz is proud to be recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Our team is committed to delivering on our promise to engage early and often for smarter, better, faster healthcare.With this commitment, you’ll find an engaged culture – one that stands strong, vigorous, and healthy in all we do.

jobs.description:
Overview

About HealthEdge:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

HealthEdge’s mission is to revolutionize healthcare through transaction automation and the enablement of real-time business and clinical engagement among healthcare payers, providers, and patients. Our team works to deliver technology that powers some of the most complex health plan organizations in the country — organizations responsible for the care and coverage of millions of members.

Our product portfolio — HealthRules Payer, GuidingCare, Wellframe, and Source — addresses the full spectrum of payer operations, from core administrative processing to care management and member engagement. We are growing, we are building, and we are looking for people who want to grow and build alongside us. If you are looking for a role where your work has direct relevance to how healthcare gets delivered, and where your development is taken seriously, HealthEdge is that place.

HealthEdge is committed to an inclusive workplace where every employee has the opportunity to belong, make an impact, and do the best work of their career. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Position Overview: We're seeking a Cloud IAM Operations Engineer to manage day-to-day identity and access provisioning across our AWS environment. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role; you'll review incoming access requests against least-privilege principles and implement approved access using Infrastructure as Code. This role operates in alignment with established policy rather than defining it, and you'll partner closely with security architecture on escalations and edge cases. 

Responsibilities:

  • Review AWS access requests against least-privilege and organizational access policy 
  • Provision and implement approved access using Infrastructure as Code (CDK preferred; or similar IaC tools considered) 
  • Manage and maintain the organization's Just-In-Time (JIT) access management tool, ensuring all human-use AWS access is provisioned on-demand through JIT workflows rather than persistent permissions, reinforcing least-privilege and audit readiness 
  • Maintain accurate, auditable records of access grants, changes, and revocations 
  • Identify and escalate access requests that fall outside standard policy or carry elevated risk 
  • Support periodic access reviews and recertification processes 
  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation to improve consistency and repeatability of the access request lifecycle 
  • Partner with security architecture and IAM leadership on process improvements and automation opportunities 
  • Conduct periodic reviews of AWS IAM permission sets using IAM Access Analyzer and other tooling to identify unused permissions and overly permissive policies, refining access controls to align with least-privilege principles across the environments. 

What you bring:

2–4 years of experience in cloud security, IAM, or cloud technologies in AWS  

Working experience with AWS IAM fundamentals (roles, policies, permission sets, least-privilege design) 

This is a people-facing role, and the ideal candidate will bring strong interpersonal and communication skills alongside relevant technical experience. 

Working experience with Infrastructure as Code (CDK preferred;  Pulumi, or CloudFormation also considered) 

Understanding of access review and audit requirements in a regulated environment 

Working experience implementing or administering Just-In-Time (JIT) access management tools in a cloud environment, with a strong understanding of least-privilege access principles and standing-access risk reduction 

Strong attention to detail and sound judgment on what access should and shouldn't be granted 

Clear written communication for documentation and access decision records 

Preferred Experience

Experience in a healthcare or other regulated industry (HIPAA/HITRUST - aware) 

Familiarity with identity governance tooling and access certification workflows 

Basic scripting ability (Python, TypeScript, or similar) to support IaC workflows 

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $107,000 to $114,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

jobs.excerpt: AECOM Hunt is seeking a technically skilled CMiC Application Support Analyst to join its Information Technology team.
jobs.description:
AECOM Hunt is seeking a technically skilled CMiC Application Support Analyst to join its Information Technology team. This role goes beyond frontline helpdesk support — we are looking for someone with hands-on experience in CMiC ERP environments who can operate fluently at the intersection of construction business processes, application configuration, and data. The ideal candidate understands how CMiC data flows across modules, can write queries to investigate and validate data, and has built or maintained reports that put operational information in the hands of business users.

This position will support the CMiC platform used daily across AECOM Hunt's project, finance, and operations teams. The right candidate is someone who has walked the path from ERP support into broader technical contribution — curious about the data behind the system, comfortable with SQL, and capable of building lasting solutions rather than just closing tickets.

This position will offer flexibility for primarily remote work schedules and can be based from a variety of locations in the US

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide CMiC application support across Finance, Job Costing, Project Management, Procurement, and Payroll modules — diagnosing configuration issues, data anomalies, workflow interruptions, and process errors.
  • Assist end users with CMiC navigation, module functionality, and business process questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and application defects.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve access issues including user account lifecycle management (create, modify, deactivate), role assignments, and permission structures aligned with job responsibilities.
  • As AECOM Hunt's corporate ERP and single source of truth for financials, CMiC sits at the center of how the business operates. Candidates who bring an understanding of how data flows through an ERP — and who are comfortable using SQL to help investigate issues or validate outputs — will find themselves well-equipped to provide meaningful support in this environment.
  • Support and maintain integration points between CMiC and adjacent systems (Textura, Concur, Prophix, CorPay, DocuSign, ClearStory, and others); candidates who have experience supporting downstream analytics or reporting platforms that consume CMiC data — such as Power BI — are strongly encouraged to apply, though this is not a requirement of the role.
  • Document issues, root causes, and resolutions to build a structured knowledge base; identify recurring patterns that merit permanent fixes or process improvements.

Minimum Requirements:

  • BA/BS in Information Technology, Business, Construction Management, or a related field + 2 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or administering a construction ERP platform — CMiC experience strongly preferred; comparable systems (Viewpoint, Procore Financials, Sage 300 CRE, or similar) considered.
  • Working knowledge of SQL — ability to write queries, investigate data, and validate results in a relational database environment (Oracle or SQL Server).
  • Familiarity with CMiC modules including Financials, Job Costing, Project Management, and/or Procurement.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills — ability to trace an issue from the user interface back to its data or configuration root cause.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across technical and business stakeholders and communicate clearly in both directions.
  • Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position
  • Qualified applications who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
  • This position does not include relocation benefits
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 11 2026.

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor - Statistics Specialist, you’ll play a key role in advancing SpaceXAI's mission by enhancing our AI technologies through high-quality inputs, labels, and annotations using specialized software. You’ll collaborate with our technical team to train models on human interactions, problem-solving, and discussions; refine annotation tools; and select/create challenging problems in statistics to boost performance.

All of our AI Tutor roles potentially involve gathering or providing data in text, voice, and video formats, including annotations, audio recordings, or video sessions—tasks with which candidates must be comfortable.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software applications to provide input/labels on defined projects.
  • Support and ensure the delivery of high-quality curated data.
  • Play a pivotal role in supporting and contributing to the training of new tasks, working closely with the technical staff to ensure the successful development and implementation of cutting-edge initiatives/technologies.
  • Interact with the technical staff to help improve the design of efficient annotation tools.
  • Choose problems from statistical domains that align with your expertise, focusing on areas such as probability theory, inferential statistics, regression modeling, multivariate analysis, stochastic processes, Bayesian methods, experimental design, and data-driven applications where you can confidently provide detailed solutions and evaluate model responses.
  • Interpret, analyze, and execute tasks based on given instructions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must have either (a) a Master’s or PhD in Statistics (or Mathematics with a specialization in statistics or probability) or (b) a medal in an International Math Olympiad (IMO), International Statistical Olympiad, or similar competition.
  • Proficiency in reading and writing, both in informal and professional English.
  • Strong ability to navigate various information resources and databases.
  • Outstanding communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational capabilities.
  • Solid reading comprehension skills combined with capacity to exercise autonomous judgment even when presented with limited data/material.
  • A strong passion for and commitment to technological advancements and innovation.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • PhD in Statistics or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Peer-reviewed publications in statistics, probability, or applied statistical modeling.
  • Previous AI Tutoring experience and/or experience teaching college-level statistics courses.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • Tutor roles may be offered as full-time, part-time, or contractor positions, depending on role needs and candidate fit.

On average most projects may involve at least 10 hours per week to achieve deliverables effectively though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables.
  • Tutor roles may be performed remotely from any location worldwide, subject to legal eligibility, time-zone compatibility, and role specific needs.
  • For US based candidates, please note we are unable to hire in the states of Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • For those who will be working from a personal device, your computer must be a Chromebook, Mac with MacOS 11.0 or later, or Windows 10 or later.

US based candidates: $45/hour - $75/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs in real-world applications.
  • Experience working with cloud-based SaaS applications and multi-tenant product considerations.
  • Familiarity with message-based or event-driven systems.
  • Experience shipping meaningful software in e-commerce, ERP, or CRM environments; e-commerce experience is especially relevant for this role.
  • Commitment to automated testing, code quality, and secure development practices, including awareness of common web security risks.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, including hands-on work with GitHub Actions or similar tooling.

Nice to have

  • Experience with approval workflows, complex pricing, or enterprise order flows.
  • Exposure to POS integrations or payment gateways.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB or other document databases.
  • Familiarity with observability practices and OTEL-style instrumentation.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools, or interest in learning within an established cloud environment.
  • Experience in hospitality, restaurant, or catering software.

Why MONKEY

This is a role where your work can have direct, visible impact on a product used in real business operations. You’ll join a team that values thoughtful engineering, practical problem solving, and steady improvement over unnecessary complexity.

🇪🇬 Up to EUR 15,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract

🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits

✨ Two exciting, high-growth businesses spanning a creative agency and a SaaS product trusted by leading global brands, particularly within sports and entertainment.
💻 Use the latest hardware, AI tools and automation technology to build smarter, more effective HR processes across Storm Ideas and Storyteller.

About Us

Most HR roles are 70% administration dressed up as strategy. We're hiring the opposite: someone who automates the 70% and spends their time on the 30% that actually matters.

We're two companies — a creative agency and a B2B SaaS platform — with just over 150 people, UK-headquartered, fully remote, hiring globally. HR here is run like an operations function: real ownership, real process, measurable output. We're now hiring someone to own it.

What You Will Own

The full HR remit, end to end:

  • Employee lifecycle — contracts, onboarding, offboarding, right-to-work, references. Built as workflows that run themselves, not checklists someone has to chase.
  • Policy & compliance — keep the handbook current with UK employment law and actually readable. No 40-page documents nobody opens.
  • Performance & comp cycles — run the review cycle, comp benchmarking, promotion cases, all backed by clean data.
  • People data — headcount, attrition, comp, tenure. Real reporting, not vibes.
  • International — contractors and employees across multiple markets: EOR arrangements, contractor compliance, offshore onboarding.

How We Expect You To Work

  • You build with AI daily. Policy redrafts, comp analysis, meeting summaries — if a model can do the first 80%, you use it, and you personally verify the last 20%.
  • You automate before you administrate. Contract generation from templates, onboarding that triggers itself, offboarding that doesn't need chasing. If you're doing the same task a third time by hand, that's a process failure.
  • You build your own tools. Airtable, HRIS admin, prompt engineering, no-code automation (Zapier/Make/Claude skills or similar). You don't file a ticket asking someone else to build your workflow.
  • You know where the line is. AI drafts; you decide. You understand exactly when model output is fine (a first-pass policy redraft) and when it absolutely is not (anything touching legal exposure or sensitive personal data). Judgement here is non-negotiable.

What This Role is Not

  • Not a "People & Culture" brand exercise. No engagement theatre, no values posters.
  • Not a coordinator role. You own outcomes, not calendars.
  • Not for anyone whose AI experience is "I've used ChatGPT to write an email." We will ask you to show us what you've built.

You'll Need

  • Solid grounding in UK employment law — contracts, policy, compliance.
  • Demonstrable AI adoption: things you've built, automated, or shipped. Evidence, not enthusiasm.
  • Technical fluency: strong in spreadsheets and HRIS admin, comfortable with automation tooling, genuinely curious about new tech and quick to adopt it.
  • Discretion, sound judgement, and the spine for hard conversations.

Nice to Have

  • CIPD or equivalent (we care far more about what you've done)
  • Experience in agency, SaaS, or high-growth tech environments
  • Multi-country / EOR experience

How to Apply

Skip the cover letter. Send your CV plus a short note on the best thing you've automated or built with AI — in HR or anywhere else. What it was, what it replaced, what it saved. That note will get more attention than your CV.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • Initial call with a member of our Head of Operations.
  • Follow-up technical exercise, which is compensated and designed to test skills relevant to the role.
  • Final interview and exercise review.

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

The Role

Lumen connects the world by helping customers bring people, data, and applications together quickly, securely, and effortlessly. We are building a culture and company from the people up, grounded in teamwork, trust, and transparency — because people power progress. In this role, you will help bring that promise to life by making the Lumen Platform tangible, compelling, and actionable for customers.

The Senior Lead Platform Activation Architect will be a key member of Partner/Product, Readiness, Incubation, Storytelling and Motion (PRISM), Lumen’s outbound, demo-led platform activation team. PRISM partners across Product, Technology, Sales, and the ecosystem to take Lumen Validated Designs and solutions to market through customer-centric narratives, interactive demos, workshops, webinars, and proof-of-value experiences. This is a building role. You do not hand a concept to someone else to make real — you make it real yourself, using AI-assisted development as your primary path from blank page to working demo.

This role bridges the builder-architect and the storyteller: technical enough to architect and build real, working demos, and compelling enough to make a customer feel the outcome. We are looking for a customer-facing technology evangelist who can understand complex solutions, translate them into business outcomes, and confidently tell a compelling story in front of customers, partners, sellers, and decision makers. The ideal candidate brings hands-on build ability and technical fluency, executive presence, curiosity, and creativity with the ability to think from the customer’s point of view and show how Lumen’s platform capabilities solve real business problems.

This role is ideal for someone energized by building something new, shaping go-to-market motions, and helping customers see what is possible with Lumen across cloud, networking, security, AI, partner technologies, and validated design experiences.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Translate Lumen Validated Designs (LVD) into customer-centric activation experiences, including narratives, demos, workshops, webinars, proof-of-value engagements, and field-ready enablement assets.
  • Build and deliver compelling customer stories that lead with business outcomes, buyer personas, and real-world use cases — not just technical features or product capabilities.

  • Apply the LVD and Demo Center of Excellence framework to ensure demos and activation experiences are validated, interactive, outcome-oriented, and aligned to the customer’s sales moment, decision points, and required level of technical depth.

Use AI-assisted development and modern web tooling to get from concept to a working, testable demo in days rather than weeks.
  • Continuously improve activation assets, customer narratives, demo flows, adoption guides, and workshop materials based on customer engagements, seller feedback, and evolving platform capabilities.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years in customer-facing technical or commercial roles such as solution activation, sales engineering, technical pre-sales, technical marketing engineering, developer advocacy, or solutions marketing. Equivalent experience as a hands-on builder in a customer-facing context counts. We care more about what you have built and presented than about the title you built it under.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to present to customers, facilitate high-impact conversations, and tell a clear, compelling story that connects technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency with the ability to understand complex platforms, architectures, integrations, and product capabilities and translate them into simple, customer-relevant messaging.
  • Experience personally building, delivering, or contributing to demos, workshops, proof-of-value engagements, webinars, customer briefings, enablement programs, or go-to-market motions at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in customer empathy, discovery, storytelling, messaging, and outcome-based solution positioning.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across product, engineering, sales, marketing, partner, and field teams with a high degree of ownership, independence, and collaboration.
  • Experience in cloud, product, software, networking, telecom, cybersecurity, AI, partner ecosystems, or large-scale technology environments preferred; telecom and networking experience are a plus, but broad technology/product orientation and customer-facing evangelism are highly valued.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms preferred.
  • You build with AI, not just about it. You use agentic coding and AI design tooling to go from a blank page to a working, interactive demo in days rather than weeks — prompting, iterating, reading the output well enough to know when it is wrong, and validating it against the real product. You are fluent enough in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to direct and correct what the tools produce.

  • Demonstrated alignment with Lumen’s culture of clarity, courage, customer obsession, growth mindset, respect, teamwork, transparency, trust, and ownership

Sales Play Manager, Revenue Operations

Location: Remote, United States

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Sales Play Manager to join our growing team in a newly created role focused on Sales Plays execution. This position is critical to the success of our go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with GTM leadership, Sales, Marketing, and Field Enablement teams to design, launch, and optimize Sales Plays that drive revenue growth.

As the Sales Play Manager, you will own the end-to-end execution of Sales Plays, from data sourcing and account matching through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role requiring strong technical skills in Salesforce, sales cadencing tools, and Excel, combined with excellent communication, problem-solving abilities, and a self-starter mentality. You'll be working in a dynamic, evolving program where adaptability and attention to detail are essential. As a member of our growing Revenue Operations team, there will be opportunities to expand your skills and grow within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Play Execution & Data Management

  • Build and manage target account lists based on propensity-to-buy attributes including industry, annual revenue, customer status, geographic territory, and other segmentation criteria
  • Identify existing Leads and Contacts to target within Sales Plays and source additional contacts using tools such as ZoomInfo and Cognism
  • Perform advanced data matching to align companies from external sources with existing Salesforce Accounts using data matching methodologies
  • Partner with SFDC Administrators to execute bulk uploads of new Accounts, Contacts, and Leads, ensuring data quality, required field population, and adherence to validation rules
  • Add prospects to the appropriate sales cadencing tool (High Velocity Sales/Salesforce Sales Engagement, SalesLoft, or Outreach.io) with proper assignee and engagement allocation
  • Validate and scrub all data against suppression lists (opt-outs, competitors, do-not-contact) and ensure compliance with data quality standards before loading into Salesforce

Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment

  • Collaborate with GTM Leadership to define Sales Play participants, territory assignments, and ownership structures; facilitate Sales leadership reviews to resolve ownership conflicts and finalize account assignments
  • Partner with Marketing and Field Enablement teams to align on lead intake processes, campaign associations, and play timing
  • Train GTM teams on leveraging tools involved in Sales Plays, including cadencing platforms, Salesforce reporting, and play-specific processes
  • Proactively communicate timelines, dependencies, and resource requirements to stakeholders; drive accountability to ensure plays launch on schedule

Monitoring, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for active Sales Plays, including engagement rates, conversion metrics, pipeline impact, and seller activity
  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards to track play performance and provide visibility to stakeholders
  • Own play performance reporting and share insights with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders based on data analysis, seller feedback, and data quality observations
  • Participate in post-play retrospectives to capture lessons learned and drive incremental improvements to the Sales Play process
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations peers to maintain and update Sales Play process documentation, including standard operating procedures, lessons learned, and best practices

Data Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Own data quality standards for Sales Plays, ensuring all records meet required field criteria, suppression list validations, and formatting consistency
  • Identify and resolve data load errors immediately post-execution; troubleshoot assignment failures, routing errors, and validation rule issues
  • Maintain suppression lists and manage data enrichment workflows to ensure compliance and data accuracy across all plays

Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2-4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or related GTM operations role; OR experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR/BDR) with hands-on prospecting, list-building, and cadencing tool experience
  • Experience working in mid-sized B2B environments preferred; must be comfortable learning and navigating complex organizational structures, including sales territories, routing logic, and GTM team hierarchies
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce architecture and data model; advanced permissions and data access experience strongly preferred
  • Advanced Salesforce reporting skills, including building complex reports and dashboards; familiarity with filters, formulas, and cross-object reporting
  • Hands-on experience using sales cadencing tools such as High Velocity Sales (Salesforce Sales Engagement), SalesLoft, or Outreach.io to enroll prospects and manage multi-touch campaigns
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, CONCATENATE), data manipulation, text-to-columns, pivot tables, and combining large datasets from multiple sources
  • Experience using contact sourcing tools such as ZoomInfo, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar data enrichment platforms
  • Understanding of GTM team structures, sales territories, and ownership models; experience working with or supporting sales teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience training or enabling sales or operations teams on tools and processes

Key Competencies

  • Self-starter with strong ownership mentality and ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and resourcefulness; able to troubleshoot technical issues and identify creative solutions
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; comfortable asking clarifying questions and engaging with stakeholders at all levels
  • Highly organized and task-oriented with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguity; this is a new program with evolving requirements, and flexibility is essential
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on partnership and driving cross-functional alignment
  • Process-oriented with experience documenting workflows and contributing to operational excellence

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with advanced Salesforce permissions, data access, and configuration
  • Experience with Pardot or other marketing automation platforms and lead management workflows
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Data Loader, DemandTools, or similar bulk data import/export tools
  • Understanding of lead routing, assignment rules, queues, and territory management within Salesforce
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services industries
  • Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM) or account-based sales strategies

This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape a new program from the ground up within a growing Revenue Operations team. If you're passionate about revenue operations, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a measurable impact on GTM success, we'd love to hear from you.

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. We have an immediate opening for a Learning Management System Administrator for Agilix Buzz. This role goes beyond keeping the platform running. You will be expected to document processes, map system interdependencies, and surface insights that help the organization make better decisions. You will serve as the internal expert and primary point of contact for systems issues, technical troubleshooting, and user support, partnering with instructional and operations teams while simultaneously building the institutional knowledge, process infrastructure, and cross-platform thinking that ensures the LMS supports organizational goals.

If you like ensuring learning technology ecosystems run smoothly, scale effectively, and deliver an exceptional experience for all users, we’re probably a good fit.

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

jobs.excerpt: About Homeaglow Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes.
jobs.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

The role

We're looking for a senior, hands-on revenue operations leader to own the analytical strategy and operational backbone of our inside sales organization. This isn't a pure analyst role and it isn't a pure ops manager role — it's someone who can build the forecasting models, design the quota structures, run the lead funnel diagnostics, and then actually fix what they find. You'll partner closely with Sales Engineering and report into the VP of Revenue once hired. The balance we need: deep comfort in the data paired with the instinct to translate it into operational decisions that actually move the business.

Who we need

A data-driven operator who has owned revenue ops or sales ops in a high-volume inside sales environment — someone who defaults to building infrastructure rather than running one-off reports. Proficient in SQL and Looker, strong in Excel/Sheets forecasting, and comfortable owning comp plan design. Runs autonomously in a remote, written-first culture and doesn't need a lot of hand-holding to figure out what matters.

Where the opportunity is

  • Build the forecasting and quota infrastructure. We don't have a rigorous, repeatable model for agent staffing forecasts or quota setting. Build it from the ground up, and own it ongoing.
  • Own the lead funnel. Monitor and diagnose the full lead flow — from distribution logic to handling efficiency to conversion — and partner with Sales Engineering to fix the bottlenecks.
  • Make the dashboards actually useful. We have Looker but the views aren't always current or trusted. Rebuild reporting so leadership and sales managers are working off the same clean numbers.
  • Design and run compensation. Own the comp plan mechanics for the inside sales org — monthly performance pay, SPIFs, team lead incentives — including the tracking and payout infrastructure.
  • Get ahead of AI displacement. This role exists in a moment where AI is starting to absorb traditional rev ops tasks. The upside: you can build a leaner, more leveraged function than anyone else has. The expectation: you'll be actively identifying what to automate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own analytical strategy for the inside sales org — proactively identify data and operational needs, don't wait to be asked.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to design, build, and implement dashboards, tools, and infrastructure that drive sales performance.
  • Design and deliver executive-level reporting: weekly sales KPIs, LTNR (Long-Term Net Revenue), and forward-looking analytics.
  • Own staffing forecasts, quota setting, and lead funnel monitoring end-to-end.
  • Manage compensation plans for 200+ agents including tracking and payout mechanics.
  • Manage operations analysts responsible for day-to-day Looker dashboard maintenance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in revenue operations or sales operations, preferably in a high-volume inside sales environment.
  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on Looker experience — you should be building views, not just reading them.
  • Expert-level Excel/Google Sheets for forecasting and workforce planning models.
  • Data-driven by default — comfortable with funnel math, cohort analysis, and comp plan modeling.
  • Organized self-starter who runs autonomously in a remote environment.
  • Strong written communication — essential for cross-functional collaboration and executive reporting.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave.
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

The Legal department at Instacart is scaling rapidly across new business models, ad formats, and retail partnerships, and the systems and workflows that support it need to keep pace. Right now, legal operations, technology, and AI enablement are evolving in parallel without a single leader owning the strategy end-to-end. This role exists to close that gap: to build the infrastructure, tooling, and team capabilities that make the legal function faster, smarter, and more accountable. Twelve months from now, Instacart will have a modern contract lifecycle management system, a deployed AI enablement program with meaningful adoption, and a legal operations team with clear KPIs and the processes to sustain them. If you thrive at the intersection of law, operations, and technology, and want to build something that lasts, this role is for you

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A high-performing legal operations team is built and running, with clear direction, performance management, and the capacity to serve the full organization.
  • An AI enablement program is live and adopted: AI-powered tools evaluated, deployed, and embedded into attorney workflows, with agentic automations reducing manual legal work and professionals upskilled across the team.
  • Legal and business operations initiatives are executed and scaled, including Go-To-Market strategies, CPQ implementations and enhancements, and Ironclad workflows supporting new ad formats, retailer engagements, and other workstreams.
  • Contract lifecycle management systems and cross-system integrations are continuously improved, with cohesive collaboration across procurement, accounting, HR, sales, deal desk, IT, and engineering, and operational savings generated from Oracle, Zip, Salesforce, and Workday integrations with CLM and P2P workflows.
  • Outside counsel operations are running with clear accountability: billing guidelines enforced, e-billing systems managed, law firm evaluations complete, and spend reporting established.
  • The team's knowledge management infrastructure is built and maintained, and KPI dashboards give leadership clear visibility into operational health.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8+ years of experience in legal operations, strategy & operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of a legal operations program and at least 3 years of direct people management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading at least two end-to-end technology implementations with deep systems integrations (e.g., Ironclad, Zip, Salesforce, CPQ, Oracle, Workday, or comparable platforms), including hands-on experience owning AI tooling, evaluating vendors, deploying tools, and building or managing AI-assisted or agentic workflows.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to drive multiple complex initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with direct experience collaborating across legal, policy, finance, IT, and business teams.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience working in a high-growth or recently public technology company with a complex, multi-jurisdictional operational footprint, including exposure to marketplace or platform businesses.

The Professional Coding Auditor reviews clinical documentation and coding to ensure accuracy, completeness, compliance, appropriate charge capture, and alignment between documentation and assigned CPT and ICD-10 codes.

This role goes beyond identifying errors—you’ll help educate providers and coders, identify trends, and partner with leadership to improve coding quality and reimbursement.

  • Experience with billing software and electronic medical records.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Strong understanding of medical coding and documentation requirements.

If you are organized, client-focused, and thrive in a fast-moving environment where every detail matters, this is your PLACE.

Who Develops You: Loan Originator / Branch Manager

What You're Great At

You are the kind of person who takes ownership of every file that crosses your desk. You are detail-oriented enough to catch the inconsistencies others miss, organized enough to juggle multiple loans in various stages at once, and people-focused enough to make every client and Realtor interaction feel seamless. You communicate proactively, follow up without being asked, and take pride in keeping transactions moving forward. You are a self-starter who does not need someone looking over your shoulder to stay on task, and you bring energy and professionalism to every interaction whether it is with a first-time homebuyer or a seasoned real estate agent.

  • Facilitate the completion of loan applications and coordinate collection of documentation including credit reports, run DU/LP/AUS, prepare loan files for processing, and send closing cost worksheets to borrowers.

  • Promote Envoy's products to Real Estate Agents, home buyers, and referral sources while tracking and managing follow-ups consistently.
  • Assist Loan Processors with putting scenarios together for prospective clients by researching client scenarios against underwriting and investor guidelines.
  • Manage a pipeline of conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA loans along with 203K and reverse mortgage products.
  • Request and gather relevant information and documents from borrowers to complete loan applications, structure, and all required disclosures.
  • Enter loan applications into the Loan Origination System (LOS) and assign to the appropriate Originator or LOA.
  • Review all loan package paperwork for inconsistencies, omissions, and inaccurate income calculations, reporting any errors to the Originator immediately.
  • Call and obtain conditions from borrowers and Realtors to clear conditions as necessary, keeping transactions moving toward close.
  • Monitor loan progress and communicate effectively with borrowers and all transaction parties on status updates throughout the process.
  • Research investor guidelines and stay current on program changes that affect processing or originating of loans in the pipeline.
  • Communicate loan approvals by sending pre-approval and commitment letters to all parties involved in the transaction.

  • Review all closing statements and compare to signed loan estimate worksheets before signings, correcting any discrepancies.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Strong understanding of the residential mortgage banking process including conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, 203K, and reverse mortgage products.
  • Ability to analyze issues and create effective resolutions while managing multiple loan files concurrently.
  • Exceptional follow-up, time management, and verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service skills and genuine comfort working in a team environment.
  • Self-starter mentality — reliable, detail-oriented, and able to resolve issues without being prompted.
  • Social media savvy and a forward-thinking approach to client relationship management.
  • Availability to work CST/EST hours is preferred.

We believe people do their best work when they are trusted, supported, and surrounded by others who are equally driven. Envoy Mortgage offers health insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, and a 401(k) plan. Compensation ranges from $21.64 to $31.25 per hour plus a bonus plan.   • Monitor network performance, resolve outages, and ensure high network availability.

Fixed Wireless Infrastructure

  • Plan, deploy, and troubleshoot Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) infrastructure.
  • Support Point-to-Point (PTP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) wireless links.
  • Work with wireless platforms including:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Aviat
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Support fixed wireless, managed Wi-Fi, Starlink, and wireless mesh/backhaul solutions.

Routing & Network Management

  • Implement and maintain dynamic routing protocols, including:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
  • Maintain reliable routing across ISP network infrastructure.
  • Support network performance optimization and stability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Flawless written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Previous experience in customer-facing technical support roles.
  • Hands-on experience with fixed wireless/WISP technologies, including:
    • Starlink
    • Managed Wi-Fi
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting MikroTik and Cisco networking equipment.
  • Experience implementing and supporting OSPF and BGP.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar platforms.
  • ITSM experience, preferably with Salesforce.
  • Experience with:
    • Starlink
    • 4G/5G networking
    • Peplink SD-WAN
  • Network certifications such as:
    • CCNA
    • Network+
    • Equivalent certifications

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Monitor network health and respond to customer support requests.
  • Troubleshoot routing, switching, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Configure and maintain MikroTik and Cisco network devices.
  • Support fixed wireless infrastructure and resolve outages.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and resolve technical issues.

  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your networking experience, and highlight your expertise with fixed wireless technologies, MikroTik, Cisco, routing protocols, and customer support. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.
